Competition categories are age-based, with scoring kept separately for each age category. Registration takes place on the running series website and closes at 16:00 on the day before the run. On-site registration is available at the times specified in the race guide. The competition offers various distances from 500 m to 27 km, with awards for the top three in every age category.

name: Tavelsjö Halvmarathon
description: Tavelsjö Half Marathon takes place on 15 August 2026 and is a pleasant summer event welcoming both runners and families. In addition to the half marathon, there is a timed youth race (2.2 km) and Tavelsjö Mini for children, making the event family-friendly. The start and finish are at Tavelsjö Church, and the organisers encourage early registration.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Tavelsjö Church
The youth race is 2.2 km long and is timed
Family-friendly event with Tavelsjö Mini for children
additional: Registration is open and is listed as closing by 15 August. The youth race is for ages 8–17, starts at 10:00, is timed, and participants receive a medal and something to eat; a prize is also drawn among the participants. Tavelsjö Mini is a popular children’s race, and gift cards are available to buy by logging in (delivery within one week of ordering). Registration opens ahead of the race; gift cards are available; parking is available at Klacken (the clubhouse), between the start and finish; race bibs can be collected during the week before the race or on race day from 09:00 to 10:45.

name: Midnattsloppet Stockholm
description: Midnattsloppet Stockholm is a festive evening race on Södermalm, taking place on 15 August 2026. It offers 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as several children’s and adaptive races. Late start times, music, spectators and activities along the course create a unique, lively atmosphere. The 21 km race covers two laps of the Midnattsloppet 10 km course, which is described as relatively hilly. The organisers highlight community, the joy of running, and the event’s appeal to both competitive runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: 21 km = two laps of the Midnattsloppet 10 km course around Södermalm
A relatively hilly course, with climbs and the character of the neighbourhood
Music, samba rhythms and spectators along the course create a festival atmosphere
additional: Start area/warm-up: Ringvägen 26. Finish: Hornsgatan 57. The entry fee includes, among other things, a Björn Borg T-shirt (this year’s colour/design), chip timing, sports drink and water along the course, and a cold Vitamin Well, fruit and an energy bar at the finish. A medal can be purchased when registering, and a digital certificate is available. The organisers accept wellness benefits from Benifex, Epassi and Benefits, and provide instructions for using a voucher code; team registration gives a discount of SEK 50 per person. Information about start groups, T-shirts and race packs, as well as dedicated pages for companies, is available on the organisers’ website. The digital Midnattsloppet takes place from 12/9 to 20/9.

name: Vasastafetten
description: Vasastafetten is a festive mass-participation relay race along the classic route from Sälen to Mora. Up to ten runners share a total distance of approximately 92 km, with legs ranging from 4.5 to 15 km. The race welcomes elite runners and recreational participants, as well as teams from clubs, companies and groups of friends. The start is in Berga by in Sälen, and the event is one of the oldest competitions of the summer week. The 2026 start time is 08:00 on August 15.
course_highlights: Trail race along the classic Sälen–Mora route
Ten legs of approximately 4.5–15 km (approximately 92 km in total)
Starts in Berga (Sälen) and finishes in Mora
additional: Race packs containing bib numbers and an information letter are sent to the team leader approximately two weeks before the race. The timing chip is collected on race day at the Vasaloppet start in Sälen, or at the race office in Mora in the days before the event. The entry fee includes bus transport for participants on legs 1 and 2. A bus ticket to the start for leg 1 must be booked; runners on leg 2 must take the organizer's bus to Smågan. Starting corrals open at 07:30, and participants should arrive by 07:55 at the latest. The timing chip is worn as a wristband, and the relay pass must be placed visibly in the windscreen. The maximum number of participating teams is 600; the minimum age is 8. Start in Sälen/Berga; finish in Mora; relay points along the course; bib number and chip required; relay checkpoints and services along the course; start documents and chip handled by the organizer.

name: 6 sjöar
location: Fjällnora friluftsgård, Uppsala Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden
description: 6 Lakes is a volunteer-run running event held on 15 August 2026, starting and finishing at Fjällnora Outdoor Recreation Centre outside Uppsala. Choose from a marathon (42 km around six lakes), a half marathon (21 km around four lakes), 10.3 km, or a shorter 5.5 km route around Lake Ramsen. All routes are well marked and feature a mix of forest trails and gravel roads. The event is environmentally conscious, with few disposable cups and the option of a reusable cup or Hydrapouch, and offers a free direct bus from Uppsala Travel Centre. It is a nature-focused race where a swim along the route may be possible in warm weather. Staggered start times let family and friends run different distances at the same time.
course_highlights: Marathon around six lakes; half marathon around four lakes, with scenic views of several bodies of water
Easy-running routes, mostly on small gravel roads and shorter trails, with a few technical sections (the 5 km route has tricky trails and bridges)
Opportunity for a swim along the route in warm weather, and aid stations along the courses
additional: Start and finish at Fjällnora Outdoor Recreation Centre. Start times: Marathon 10:00, Half Marathon 10:30, 10 km 11:00, 5 km 11:30. Race bibs can be collected at Uppsala Travel Centre on the Thursday or Friday before the event, from 11:00 to 19:00, or at the venue no later than 30 minutes before the start. Free direct buses from Uppsala Travel Centre use fossil-free fuel; the organiser will publish information and a timetable. The event avoids disposable cups: bring your own bottle or get a free reusable cup/Hydrapouch. Free T-shirts are not provided, but one can be purchased after the finish. The event is run by volunteers. For questions, contact info@6sjoar.se; a phone number for registration enquiries is listed on the contact page. Detailed maps and GPX files are available via the “Choose a race” page. Registration is online, and race bibs can be collected at Uppsala Travel Centre or before the start.

name: 15. ETAPP / Vabaõhumuuseum
description: Tervisejooks and Walk is a multi-stage running and walking event held in various areas of Tallinn, including the Estonian Open Air Museum. Each stage offers a chance to enjoy beautiful nature trails and the pleasure of recreational sport. The Estonian Open Air Museum stage is 4.2 km long and is well suited to both runners and walkers who want to spend time actively outdoors. The event is a tradition and is open to everyone interested in recreational sport.
course_highlights: A 4.2 km route on the grounds of the Estonian Open Air Museum
A pleasant, peaceful natural setting
Suitable for both runners and walkers
additional: The stages take place on different weeks, and the registration period for each stage usually lasts one week. The event is held virtually, allowing participants to take part at a time that suits them during the registration period. The event is part of a recreational sports series that aims to promote healthy lifestyles and offer participants enjoyable, health-promoting experiences in a historic setting.

name: Convinistafetten
location: Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Welcome to Convinistafetten in Stockholm—a festive, team-building relay at Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården. The event takes place over two late-summer evenings (19–20 August 2026). Each team has five people, and each participant runs 5 km. There is also a walking category for those who want to walk together. As an extra treat, title sponsor Convini provides every team with a picnic after the finish.
course_highlights: Five legs of 5 km—each team member runs 5 km
Start and finish area by the exchange zone at Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården
A picnic on the grass after the finish (provided for all teams by Convini)
additional: Teams register as a group of five. The walking team starts separately, and everyone in the team walks 5 km together. The team captain registers the team and receives information and all five race bibs by post; the runner on the final leg collects the picnic box from the picnic tent. A picnic is included in the entry (contents will be announced in May), and extra picnic boxes can be booked for SEK 495 each. Tent packages (Basic or Premium) are available as optional add-ons; orders are confirmed and tent locations communicated before the event. The minimum age for running 5 km is 13. A walking category is available; start times are assigned according to race number (for example, the first team starts at 17:30, followed by later teams at 17:33 and 17:36). Chip timing is included in the race bib. Changing rooms are available at Frescati Sports Center for SEK 40. RSIF offers a subsidised member price, with a deadline of 16 August at 18:00 to get a discount code. Information about parking and public transport is available.

name: IRONKIDS Tallinn 2026
location: Rocca Al Mare Kaubanduskeskus, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: IRONKIDS Tallinn 2026 is a children’s running competition held around Rocca al Mare Shopping Centre and Unibet Arena. The event is intended for different age groups and offers three distances: 350 m, 830 m and 1500 m. Starts are mass starts or rolling starts, with separate starts for boys and girls. Participants must wear the shirt provided by the organiser. The event is professionally organised, with timing on the longer distances and prizes and certificates for finishers.
course_highlights: The running routes follow roads around Rocca al Mare Shopping Centre and Unibet Arena
Mass start for the 400 m distance; rolling starts at intervals for the 830 m and 1500 m races
Separate classifications for boys and girls by age group
additional: On-site registration and kit collection take place at Rocca al Mare Shopping Centre on 19 August from 14.00 to 19.00 and on 20 August from 10.00 to 18.30. Participants must wear the shirt provided by the organiser and attach their race number to the front of their shirt. Start groups are marked with a coloured dot on the race number. The entry fee includes professional event organisation, timing for the 830 m and 1500 m distances, a finisher’s prize and an electronic certificate. The event is open to children born in 2019 or later. Registration closes on 18 August 2026, and the maximum number of participants is 1800.

name: 10. Üts Ummamuudu liina üüjuusk-kõnd
description: The 10th Üts Ummamuudu City Night Run-Walk is a physical activity event in the city of Võru, featuring running, Nordic walking and walking. The event is part of the activities of the Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity, which aims to promote an active lifestyle and good health. It welcomes everyone who wants to improve their wellbeing and enjoy exercise at different stages of life. The beautiful nature of Võru County provides a pleasant setting for physical activity.
course_highlights: Landscapes of the city and county of Võru
Suitable for running, Nordic walking and walking
Exercise for wellbeing and good health
additional: Võru city, Võru County; entry fees: free for children, €2 for others; registration via Stebby; chip timing and participation terms are provided

name: Sunset Run 2026
description: Sunset Run is a 5 km running and Nordic walking event held on the shared-use paths at Stroomi Beach and near Unibet Arena in Tallinn. The competition follows the competition regulations of the Estonian Athletics Association and is open to anyone who is sufficiently trained. Participants may complete the distance by running, walking or Nordic walking; walkers and Nordic walkers start at the back of the participant field. Separate age-group classifications are held for men and women. The event is organised by MTÜ Sportlik Eesti and MTÜ Triatloniakadeemia, which ensure professional organisation and participant comfort.
course_highlights: 5 km route on the shared-use paths at Stroomi Beach
Participants can run, walk or Nordic walk
The event takes place in the evening, with the start at 20:30
additional: Online registration is open until 23:59 on 18 August 2026. On-site registration and race-pack collection take place at Rocca al Mare Centre on 19 August from 14:00 to 19:00 and on race day, 20 August, from 10:00 to 17:00; they are also available by the Stroomi Beach Pavilion on 20 August from 18:30 to 20:15. Transfers to another participant are possible for an additional fee of €10 until 18 August 2026. The participation fee is paid via a bank link after completing the registration form. Age-group classifications apply, and participants take part at their own risk. The race offers running, walking and Nordic walking options; online and on-site registration; a 20:30 start; and a route on coastal paths and a promenade.

name: Askes Fjällmaraton
location: Torget vid Idre Fjäll, Idre, Älvdalen, Dalarna, Sweden
description: Askes Mountain Marathon is a short, family-friendly mountain race for children born in 2013 or later. The race takes place on Friday, 21 August, with a mass start at 18:00 and the start and finish at Torget at Idre Fjäll. The course is 1 km, well marked and untimed; a medal and a treat await at the finish. All proceeds from Askes Mountain Marathon go to the Viggo Foundation.
course_highlights: Well-marked 1 km course adapted for children
Start and finish at Torget at Idre Fjäll (mass start at 18:00)
Untimed; medal and a treat at the finish
additional: Register online until 15 minutes before the start or on-site at bib collection (payment by Swish); no timing; medal and a treat at the finish; all proceeds go to the Viggo Foundation. Part of the Craft Idre Fjällmaraton weekend, with family activities in the Askes area.

name: Lüganuse rahvajooks
location: Kiviõli keskväljak, Kiviõli, Lüganuse vald, Ida-Viru maakond, Estonia
description: Lüganuse Public Run is part of the Ida-Viru running series and takes place at Kiviõli Central Square. The event offers several distances, from a children’s run to a 9 km run, and is suitable for different age groups and skill levels. Participants can enjoy a friendly, community atmosphere and compete in the friends’ group category. Registration is straightforward and the entry fee affordable, making this a great event for recreational and experienced runners alike.
course_highlights: Several distances: from the 300 m children’s run to the 9 km run
The race takes place at Kiviõli Central Square
Friends’ group category and a community-focused competition
additional: Participants can choose the Bronto children’s run (300 m), 2 km, 5 km or 9 km distances. The race office at the event centre is open from 10:30 to 11:55. Awards for all age groups will be presented together 15 minutes after the last competitor finishes. Competitors take part at their own risk. The entry fee can be paid on site in cash or via Stebby. The race takes place at Kiviõli Central Square. Registration is open both online and on site, and participants can choose from several distances.

name: Ultravasan
description: Ultravasan 90 is a trail race starting in Berga by, Sälen, offering runners the classic Vasaloppet route through scenic summer landscapes. The race starts at dawn at 05:00 and follows the historic checkpoints to the finish in Mora, with views of pine forests, waterways, trails and traditional mountain farm settings. The race is 92 km long, has Swedish Championship status in 2026 and is part of Vasaloppstrippeln; the maximum number of participants is 2,500, and the minimum age is 17.
course_highlights: Dawn start at 05:00 in Berga by—watch the sun rise over the marshes around Smågan
Seven Vasaloppet checkpoints along the course, with drinks, energy, toilets and medical care
Scenic stretches through open pine forests, winding waterways, well-trodden trails and picturesque traditional mountain farm settings
additional: Race bibs and chips can be collected in Mora or Sälen in the days before the race, or at the start venue. Start pens open at 04:30, and your time starts when you cross the start line. Baggage transport to Mora is available, and you can send a change-of-clothes bag to Evertsberg. There are refreshment stations approximately every five kilometres, as well as toilets and medical care at all checkpoints. Maximum 2,500 participants; training grants of SEK 60,000 are awarded to the winner in each of the women’s and men’s categories. Ultravasan consists of two longer ultramarathon distances: Ultravasan 90 (Sälen–Mora, approximately 92 km) and Ultravasan 45 (Oxberg–Mora, approximately 45 km). Both finish in Mora and are part of Vasaloppet’s Summer Week.

name: Stockholm Trail
location: Hammarbyhöjdens IP, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Dreaming of winding trails, sunlit rock slabs and delightful descents? Stockholm Trail offers several well-marked trail races in beautiful Nacka Nature Reserve, starting and finishing at Hammarbyhöjden IP, close to central Stockholm. The course suits both experienced trail runners and recreational runners looking to try trail running. Welcome to a challenging, sweaty and memorable trail event with encouraging race marshals and great service.
course_highlights: Technical forest trails and beautiful rock slabs with fantastic views in Nacka Nature Reserve
Start and finish at Hammarbyhöjden IP, about a 5-minute walk from Hammarbyhöjden metro station
Several aid stations (Umara sports drink) and a race bib with your name
additional: Start and finish at Hammarbyhöjden IP; race bibs can be collected on Friday 21/8 at Best Western Park City Hammarby Sjöstad, 16:00–19:00, or at the venue from 09:00 on race day. A wooden medal from Raw Cut Studio awaits finishers. Bag drop (supervised, free); indoor showers and changing facilities available. Name and distance changes are free until 8 August (contact sekretariat@stockholmtrail.se). Minimum age for the 21K is 18; time limits: 4 hours for the 21K and 3 hours for the 10K. Aid stations with water and Umara sports drink: the 21K passes 5 stations, the 10K 3 stations and the 5K 1 station. Premium packages with a T-shirt and training sessions are available; T-shirts can be purchased separately (349 SEK). Results are published online straight after the finish; there will be a speaker, music and refreshments at the venue. Distances include 21K, 10K, 5K, 5K Fun Run and 2.5K Minitrail; start/finish at Hammarbyhöjden IP; aid and energy stations along the course; bag drop and race-bib collection; the finish area offers drinks, coffee and refreshments, as well as indoor showers and changing facilities; this year, T-shirts will not be sold at the venue (buy them from Bagheera’s shop).

name: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100
description: Hjorthagen Ultra Trail 100 is an ultramarathon in Lill-Jansskogen in Stockholm, with a choice of 50 or 100 miles. The race celebrates endurance, nature experiences and community, and is run by Nisse and Anna Larsson through the Hjorthagen Ultra SC association. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggans väg 22, with ample parking and easy access to the metro and buses. Start times are 09:00 for 100 miles and 14:00 for 50 miles.
course_highlights: Magical forest sections in Lill-Jansskogen
Steep hills and plenty of elevation gain
Start/finish at Stora Skuggans väg 22, with good access to parking and public transport
additional: Cut-off times are 32 hours for 100 miles and 16 hours for 50 miles. Maximum 100 participants. Start times: 100 miles at 09:00 and 50 miles at 14:00. Surplus funds go to Suicide Zero.

description: Fjällvindenterrängen is a classic 10-kilometre mountain trail race from Laisaliden to Hemavan. The race offers beautiful mountain scenery along Drottningleden and finishes with a run through the ski area, with the finish at the lower station of Centrumliftet next to Anders Bistro. The race starts at 12:30 with a group warm-up, and the number of places is limited to 200 participants. The entry fee includes more than just the race, including bus transport to the start and energy at the finish.
course_highlights: The course follows Drottningleden across the mountain on a clearly marked trail with orange markings
Crossing of Mortsbäcken via a bridge approximately 7 km from the start
A downhill run through the ski area, finishing at the lower station of Centrumliftet
additional: Bus transport to the start in Laisaliden is included, departing at 11:30 from the Centrumhuset car park in Hemavan. There is a staffed water station after approximately 5–6 km. After the finish, energy, drinks and fruit are available, and food and fika can be purchased at Anders Bistro. A unique, handmade wooden medal is awarded to everyone who finishes, and the medal entitles the holder to a return trip on the Hemavan Gondola the weekend after the race. The prize-giving takes place at 14:30 in the finish area. Toilets are available in Centrumhuset, but there are no showers. Warm-up clothes can be left at the start for transport to the finish. The race takes place on 29 August 2026, starting in Laisaliden and finishing in Hemavan. The event also includes family activities and the children’s race Tough Kidz.

name: Blodomloppet – Sundsvall
location: Ungdomsfältet i Södra hamnen, Sundsvall, Sweden
price_range: 5 km: 350–450 kr; 10 km: 350–450 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet: 100 kr; lagavgift: 1 750–2 000 kr; blodgivare rabatt: 40 kr
description: Blodomloppet in Sundsvall is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation while promoting health and community. The race has moved from Timrå and is held at Ungdomsfältet in Södra hamnen, a central and accessible venue with views of the harbour area. The event offers 5 km and 10 km races (timed), a walking category, and Lilla Blodomloppet for children, and is part of the national Blodomloppet series. Part of the entry fee goes back to local sports activities.
course_highlights: Venue at Ungdomsfältet in Södra hamnen, near the marina
5 km and 10 km courses approved by the Swedish Athletics Association; the courses run counterclockwise and cross Selångersån (the 5 km course via Sporthallsbron, the 10 km course via Montörsvägsbron)
Lilla Blodomloppet offers courses of approximately 600 m and 1,600 m in the harbour area next to the venue
additional: A picnic bag for 5 people is included in the team entry fee; teams can register 5 people but leave 1–2 places vacant and fill them later by email no later than 18 August; blood donors receive a 40 kr discount per person; payment can be made by card or Swish; on-site late registration for individuals opens at 15:30 on race day (increased fee of 450 kr); the courses are officially measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association; Lilla Blodomloppet offers shorter courses of approximately 600 m and 1,600 m. Courses: 5 km and 10 km for adults (counterclockwise); Lilla Blodomloppet in the harbour area (600 m and 1,600 m). Venue: Ungdomsfältet in Södra hamnen. Enter individually or as a team (5 per team); registration deadline: 25 August; late registration is available for a higher fee; payment by card or Swish; a picnic bag is included in the team entry fee.

name: Blodomloppet Västerås
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Västerås at Rocklunda IP on 26 August 2026—a fun run for everyone, where you can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km. Lilla Blodomloppet offers two children’s races (approx. 1,400 m and approx. 500 m), with a warm-up and the finish under the finish arch. The event is held to raise awareness of the need for blood donation and traditionally ends with a picnic for teams and participants. You can register individually or as part of a team (3–5 people); information and event details are available on the event website.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Rocklunda area (the football pitches north of the riding arena)
The 5 km and 10 km courses are marked, with course marshals positioned along the routes
Lilla Blodomloppet: two children’s distances (~1,400 m, starting at 17:15, and ~500 m, starting at 17:25), finishing under the finish arch
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (3–5 participants; the fee is always for 5 participants and includes a picnic for 5). Teams can be topped up to a maximum of 5 people until Monday 24/8, and the final date for team registration is stated as 19/8; larger companies can arrange a customer page/discount code. Children taking part in Lilla Blodomloppet receive a medal and a finish-line bag from ICA Maxi Hälla. The warm-up is in front of the stage at approximately 17:00, and children choose their distance on site. Registration is binding, cancellations are not accepted, and registration is open until 26/8 at 17:30. Course and map materials are available on the event website (link to map/course map). Register via the website or on site at Rocklunda IP from 15:00; 25 August according to the information page; includes a technical T-shirt, race bib and medal. Team registration is available for 3–5 participants, with the regular registration deadline on 20 August. The course route and start times will be announced by the organisers.

name: Norrköpings Stadslopp (Nkpg City)
description: NKPG City Norrköpings Stadslopp is organized by Tjalve Friidrott Norrköping and starts and finishes on Olai Kyrkogata in the heart of Norrköping. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances (10 km is 2 x 5 km), as well as the free children’s race, Lilla Lundbergsloppet. The course passes through classic Norrköping settings, with large crowds lining the route, several music stations, and a mix of elite runners and recreational runners. Finishers receive medals and sponsored products. Team registration is available, and runners can choose timed or untimed participation.
course_highlights: A city course through classic Norrköping settings, with large crowds lining the route
More than ten music stations along the course to keep runners motivated
10 km = 2 x 5 km; start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata
additional: Start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata by Hötorget. Start times: Lilla Lundbergsloppet from 17:00 (four starts 15 minutes apart), 10 km at 18:30, 5 km at 19:30. Timed or untimed participation is available for the 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Lundbergsloppet (approx. 1,000 m) is free and limited to a maximum of 1,100 children; all children receive a medal and a goodie bag. Bib pickup: XXL Ingelsta on Tuesday 26 August, 11:00–18:00, and in the partner village at the start and finish area on Wednesday 27 August from 15:00 (late registration for the 5 km and 10 km is possible at both bib pickup locations). Start lists and information about your bib number will be published from the afternoon of Monday 25 August. Distance options: 5 km and 10 km; Lilla Lundbergsloppet is a free 1 km race for children; start and finish on Olai Kyrkogata; the course passes Linden shopping centre and features music stations along the way; Lilla Lundbergsloppet is limited to 1,100 children; all participants receive a medal and a goodie bag; the official results page is available online.

name: Höga Kusten Trail
distance_verbose: 60 km, 50 km, 32 km, 28 km, 18 km, 14 km
description: Höga Kusten Trail is a two-day trail-running weekend with five distances that takes you through the High Coast World Heritage Site. The races are for both beginners and experienced participants and combine running, power hiking and spectacular views. The event includes race briefings, a small expo with equipment exhibitors, and shared after-trail celebrations at FriluftsByn.
course_highlights: The courses run through the High Coast World Heritage Site and pass several dramatic peaks (e.g. Skuleberget).
Five distances with varied terrain and technical sections: Twin Peaks 14k, 3Peaks 18k, Coast to Summits 28/32k, The Original 45k and The Ultimate 60k.
Course marshals and aid stations along the route; buses from FriluftsByn to the start.
additional: A race briefing is held before each distance, and there is a small expo where Icebug and Haglöfs showcase equipment. The Original 45k has a 12-hour time limit, and buses run from FriluftsByn to the start (for example, 07:30 - 08:30 for Original). There are aid stations and course marshals along the route, the option to sell your race entry in the participants’ Facebook group, and optional insurance through Startklar. After-Trail and shared evening gatherings are part of the event, and the organisers also offer Trail-Camps. Participants take part in a two-day weekend with five distances; race briefings before each distance; Trail Camp and various pre- and post-events; start and finish locations at FriluftsByn and Skuleberget; and a race that passes iconic viewpoints in the High Coast World Heritage Site.

description: The 22nd Ülemiste Forest Run is an environmentally friendly 3 km trail run held around the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant. The event centre, start and finish are located at Järvevana tee 3. The race takes place on Saturday, 29 August 2026, starting at 11:50. Participants are provided with a marked course, sports drink and water at the finish, and medical assistance along the entire route. The event is open to everyone interested in running and offers an enjoyable, athletic experience.
course_highlights: A 3 km forest trail around the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant
A marked course, with sports drink and water at the finish
Medical assistance along the entire route
additional: Race pack distribution and on-site registration begin at 9:30; payment can be made in cash. Timing is recorded using a chip attached to the back of the race number. Participants receive a medal, race number, timing, a result in the official results, services, sports drink and water at the finish. The event centre is on the grounds of the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant; parking and access are signposted. Children’s races for participants up to 12 years old are free and take place before the main race. The event includes a hiking trail, registration is on site, and family activities and warm-up exercises are also offered.

description: Sillamäe Ultra 2026 is the Estonian 100 km running championships, held on the Sillamäe health trail and at the outdoor fitness areas on August 29, 2026. This is a traditional ultramarathon in which participants cover a road-running distance and compete for the Estonian championship title. The race offers a challenge to local and international ultrarunners who appreciate the variety of the course and the event’s organization. Sillamäe Ultra is known for its organization and strong participant community.
course_highlights: 100 km road race on the Sillamäe health trail and at the outdoor fitness areas
Estonian ultrarunning championships
Varied, well-organized course
additional: Participants can also enter the 50 km, 6-hour, and 12-hour races. There are facilities along the course for changing clothes and washing. Prizes are awarded to Estonia’s top runners, and the event is part of the Estonian ultrarunning championships.

description: The 54th Tallinn Water Run Around Lake Ülemiste is a traditional running race taking place on 29 August 2026. The Run Around Lake Ülemiste is part of the Maru Lake Run Series, and this year’s race is the final, fourth event in the series. The marked course is 13.7 km long and starts and finishes at the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant, Järvevana tee 3. The race centre opens early in the morning, and race materials can be collected on site. Participants are provided with chip timing; the chip is attached to the back of the race bib.
course_highlights: A 13.7 km course around Lake Ülemiste
The course is marked and secured by course marshals
There are two water stations on the course
additional: Previous results are taken into account when forming start groups. All Nordic walkers must start in the last group. Participants receive a medal, and timing is provided by a chip attached to the back of the race bib. Children’s races for those up to 12 years old are free, with a distance of 250 m. Race materials can be collected at the race centre from 9:30 to 11:30. The race centre and start/finish are at the Tallinn Water Treatment Plant, Järvevana tee 3. The distance is 13.7 km, and the start and finish are at Järvevana tee 3. The event also includes a children’s race and a forest run, offering a varied experience for all participants.

name: Stockholm Halvmarathon
location: Kungliga slottet, Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: The adidas Stockholm Half Marathon is a 21,098-metre half marathon that in 2026 will make its 25th run through central Stockholm. The course is unique, with both the start and finish in the area between the Royal Palace, the Parliament Building and the Opera House. It offers easy-to-run streets through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm. The first start is at 15:30. The event also includes an Expo and race-bib collection in Kungsträdgården from 27–29 August, as well as an after-run gathering in Kungsträdgården. The race is open to anyone turning 17 that year, and registration is binding.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the area by the Royal Palace/Norrbro, in the heart of the city
Easy-to-run course through Norrmalm, Vasastan, Kungsholmen, Gamla Stan and Södermalm
Passes, among other places, Hornsbergstrand, Rålambshovsparken and Söder Mälarstrand; detailed kilometre-by-kilometre course information is available on the course map

description: Rynningeviken Longer is a timed race in the Rynningeviken Nature Reserve outside Örebro, where participants run as far as they can in either three or six hours. The course follows scenic trails along Lake Hjälmaren and the Svartån River. It is relatively technical but fast, and just a stone’s throw from the city centre. The race is open to all running styles and abilities—from walking to ultrarunning—and offers a community-focused day with support and aid stations. A separate KidsRun for the youngest participants is also part of the event.
course_highlights: 2,412.5-metre loop, mostly gravel paths
Two bridges account for the few metres of elevation; start/finish on cobblestones
Final 508-metre loop for the closing measurement, reducing wait time at the finish
additional: Start times and mandatory briefings: 6-hour race starts at 11:00 (briefing at 10:45); 3-hour race starts at 14:00 (briefing at 13:45); KidsRun starts at 11:30 (briefing at 11:15). Location: Gamla Oljehamnen, below Naturens hus; parking along Oljevägen. Timing uses a transponder borrowed at bib collection (a lost transponder incurs a charge of SEK 800); the final measurement is verified with a measuring wheel. There is no individual timekeeping—the result is the distance covered when time expires. Umara sports drink and water are provided, along with a well-stocked energy table (bars, fruit, crisps, pickled cucumber, Tosca cake and more). No changing rooms or showers are available. Public toilets are located at the start and about 1 km along the course. Registration is only through the partner AnmälMigNu (group and corporate registration via info@epictrail.se). Young people (born in 2008 or later) receive a 50% discount. KidsRun participants receive a medal, Festis and ice cream. The course loop is approximately 2,412.5 m, with two bridges and a final 508 m loop. Energy and fluids are provided (Umara). No changing rooms or showers are offered; toilets are near the start and about 1 km along the course. Registration window: 24–29 August. The 50% youth discount applies to those born in 2008 or later. Registration includes a place, bib, timing, a unique medal, sports drink and energy along the course. Register via AnmälMigNu; group/corporate registration via info@epictrail.se. Cancellation and insurance options are available; participation is at your own risk.

name: Kraftloppet Skellefteå Löpning 2026
description: Kraftloppet in Skellefteå is a series of recreational races organised by Bergsbyns SK, for both enthusiastic recreational runners and competitive athletes. The races take place on 29 August 2026 and offer distances for adults (21 km and 12 km) as well as children’s races (2.7 km and 500 m). You can take part in the races individually or as part of Kraftklassikern, completing skiing, cycling and running in the same calendar year. The event is presented as a community celebration focused on health and togetherness.
course_highlights: Running race distances: 21 km and 12 km
Children’s races: 2.7 km and 500 m
The race can be part of Kraftklassikern (combining skiing, cycling and running in the same calendar year)
additional: Organiser: Bergsbyns SK, address Falmyrvägen 66, 931 53 Skellefteå. Contact by phone at +46 (0)910-861 61 or by email at info@kraftloppet.com. Register via the links on the registration page (anmaelan). Once you have completed all three races in the same calendar year, notify the club administrator before 30 September to receive the Kraftklassiker reward. Follow the event on Facebook for information ahead of the races. Registration is available via the registration page; the race takes place on 29 August 2026 in Skellefteå (Bergsbyns SK, Falmyrvägen 66); results links are available for running and the other disciplines.

name: Dundret Extreme Running
description: Dundret Extreme Running (DXR) is a challenging recreational race held in late August on Dundret in Gällivare. The race has a long history, dating back to its first edition in 1997, and offers several distances across varied terrain, including sections of off-trail running and bog running. The longest course is 22 km with approximately 700 metres of elevation gain. Runners climb to the mountain prize at Dundret’s mast summit, then run around the peaks before finishing at Hellnerstadion. DXR is a race for runners who want to test their endurance and enjoy the beautiful mountain scenery.
course_highlights: 22 km course with 700 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at Hellnerstadion
Mountain prize at Dundret’s mast summit and varied terrain including trails, paths and paved road
additional: The 22 km route follows marked trails and paved road. Shorter distances (2 km, 6 km, 10 km and 14 km) are also available, with sections of bog running and a start from the summit; a lift ticket to the start is included (though the lift has been unavailable in some years due to operational disruptions). More information about the shorter distances is available on DXR’s own website. Trail running, elevation gain, lift ticket included for certain distances, registration via MittLopp.se, no on-site registration.

description: The Northern Lithuania Half Marathon 2026 will take place in Pakruojis District, in the northern part of Lithuania. The event aims to promote running culture and encourage residents to be active, offering scenic routes in popular tourist areas. The race will start and finish in Pakruojis City Park, where participants can enjoy not only the sport but also discover the nature and culture of northern Lithuania. The event brings together people of different ages and social groups to spend time actively and healthily.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in popular tourist areas
Start and finish in Pakruojis City Park
Discover northern Lithuania while running

The event includes different distances and categories, and online registration is open until the end of August. The event date is September 4, 2027.

The event centre, start and finish are located beside Löwenruh Park, providing a pleasant and safe setting for running enthusiasts. The event aims to promote running as an accessible form of exercise and offer a sporting experience for different age groups.

name: Vikingatrailen

Held in the Mägede sports area in Järvamaa

description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional running event in Pärnu, held on the first weekend of September. The event takes place in the scenic area of Pärnu and its bridges, offering a sporting experience for participants of all ages. It is organised by the Pärnu Two Bridges Club, which invites everyone to get active and enjoy moving.
course_highlights: 10 km run and Nordic walking in Pärnu’s scenic bridge area
Pärnu Evening Run over a 3 km distance
Children’s races and a wheelchair race on Family Day
additional: The event includes both timed and untimed distances, as well as a Family Day with children’s races and a wheelchair race. The event centre is located by Endla Theatre. Registration takes place in several waves, allowing early registrants to get lower prices. This family event offers a variety of running and walking activities, as well as the chance to enjoy activities organised by local sports clubs and hobby schools. Registration and further information are available on the organiser’s website.

name: 15. Kütioru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: The Kütioru trail run and walk is part of the Võrumaa Running and Walking Series, offering a range of distances for both runners and walkers. The event takes place at the Kütioru Ski Centre, and the course is off-road, providing a varied running experience. The series includes distances ranging from children’s races to the main events, with options for all levels. This traditional event is open to everyone interested in sport who wants to enjoy Võrumaa’s beautiful nature and friendly sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Off-road course around the Kütioru Ski Centre
A range of distances, from children’s races to the main events
Enjoy Võrumaa’s beautiful nature and varied terrain
additional: The series offers running and walking events for different age groups and ability levels. The course may include asphalt and gravel roads as well as softer ground. Children’s races take place in separate areas. An event centre and transport arrangements are usually provided, but check the season’s guide for details. Participants can enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings and varied terrain. The event is part of the Võrumaa Running and Walking Series, which features different distances and age groups.

name: Pärnu Õhtujooks ja Kahe Silla jooksu ratastoolisõit ja lastejooksud

price_tiers.distance: Jüri Jaansoni Kahe Silla jooks 10 km

description: Jüri Jaanson’s Two Bridges Run is a traditional sporting event in Pärnu that brings together thousands of running enthusiasts on the first weekend of September. The event takes place in Vaasa Park and offers various distances and ways to participate, including an evening run, a wheelchair race and children’s races. The Two Bridges Run is known for its beautiful urban course along the bridges, offering a sporting challenge and a pleasant atmosphere for all participants. The event is open to both recreational and experienced runners and celebrates the joy of movement and community spirit.
course_highlights: 10 km run and walk on a beautiful course in Vaasa Park
Evening run and family day with children’s races
Wheelchair race for an inclusive sporting experience
additional: The family day also features children’s races and a wheelchair race. The events take place in Vaasa Park. Walking is also available as part of the event. Registration is on the website, which also provides guidelines and entry fees. The event is timed. It offers several running and movement activities, including children’s races, a wheelchair race and the main 10 km run, which passes scenic views of the Pärnu River and the city.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is an iconic 10 km race for women, taking place in 2026 on Southern Djurgården and through central Stockholm on 5 September. The race is suitable for all levels—from walking to fast running—and is divided into start groups to ensure a smooth race flow. The course draws large crowds and combines scenic sections with urban surroundings. Timing is optional, and prize money is awarded to the top 3.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Southern Djurgården and through the beautiful surroundings of central Stockholm
Plenty of crowd support along the course and a high-energy atmosphere
Option to shorten the race to approximately 6 km (start group 12) for those who wish
additional: Timing is included but can be opted out of; registration is binding. Late registration is available digitally, subject to availability, until 1 hour before the first start. Payment options: online banking, Visa/Mastercard, Swish or invoice via Klarna. The minimum age for Tjejmilen Stockholm is 15 in the year you turn 15 (13 when accompanied by an adult). The start is divided into 12 start groups, and prize money is awarded to the top 3. Two 10 km races for women (Sälen trail and Stockholm City race); start groups; minimum age 15; late registration may be available; dogs are not permitted; planning information is available on the official page.

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
description: Blodomloppet in Eskilstuna takes place on 7 September 2026 and is organised by Eskilstuna Friidrott. The event offers women’s and men’s 5 km and 10 km races, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet. The courses are described as fast and flat. The event is held in Stadsparken and combines recreational running with the aim of raising awareness of blood donation, including through a donor gift and a picnic tradition. Information and event details are published on the event page, and participants can register individually or as a team.
course_highlights: A fast, flat course with very little elevation change
The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured
The start and event area are in Stadsparken
additional: Participants can register individually or as a team (maximum 5 people per team); members of the same team can take part in different distances. For larger registrations, an Excel template can be downloaded from the registration page, and the organiser can help set up a customer page or discount code for companies with more than 20 participants. Blood donor gifts are distributed at the Unilabs blood donor centre tent in the event area. Bag storage/drop-off is available (drop-off and collection are listed as 17:00–20:00). Course distances: 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Blodomloppet is 800 m. The event area includes bag drop and a picnic bag; participants can register individually or as a team (maximum 5 people per team).

name: Self-Transcendence 2 mailin juoksu, Vaasa
description: Self-Transcendence 2 mailin juoksu Vaasa järjestetään joka tiistai toukokuusta syyskuuhun klo 19.00 Hietalahden rauhanmaililla. Reitti on 1 mailin mittainen puistoreitti, joka kierretään kaksi kertaa. Lähtö ja ilmoittautuminen tapahtuvat uimahallin takana. Juoksu tarjoaa nopean ja miellyttävän puistoreitin, joka sopii kaikentasoisille juoksijoille.
course_highlights: 1 mailin mittainen puistoreitti
Reitti kierretään kaksi kertaa
Lähtö ja ilmoittautuminen uimahallin takana
additional: Juoksut järjestetään joka tiistai toukokuusta syyskuuhun. Kilpailussa on useita sarjoja eri ikäryhmille. Tulokset ovat nähtävillä aiemmilta vuosilta. Järjestäjänä toimii Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, joka on palvellut juoksuyhteisöä yli 35 vuotta. Tapahtuma järjestetään joka tiistai klo 19 syyskuuhun asti, ja osallistumismaksu ei ole erikseen mainittu.

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus i Skärblacka, Skärblacka, Östergötland, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird, 250 kr, fram till och med 30 april 23:59.

description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual fun run in Skärblacka, offering a festival atmosphere for runners and spectators. The main race is 6 km through the town, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus. There is also a 4 km walking class and a 900 m Little Children’s Race. The race is open to all levels and features generous prizes, lotteries and goodie bags for participants. Organisers Frida Södermark and Stefan Fransson warmly welcome everyone to the starting line on 9 September 2026.
course_highlights: 6 km through Skärblacka, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus
The course includes asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and some trails
4 km walking class (shortened course) and 900 m Little Children’s Race near Parkskolan
additional: Start and finish at Folkets Hus in Skärblacka. Race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on Tuesday 8 September, 11:00–18:00; any remaining race numbers will be handed out at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late entries are available when collecting race numbers. All participants receive a goodie bag; prizes, a sprint prize and lotteries are offered (including a tyre prize and course-record bonus). The walking class was introduced in 2024; race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka; registration is via raceid; late registration is available on race day from 15:30; payment is accepted only by Swish or cash; a chip in the race number records the time; medical care, food and drink are available on site.

name: Finlandiaviesti
location: Jyväskylä, Rantaraitti, Jyväskylä, Central Finland, Finland
description: Finlandiaviesti 1/2026 on osa Finlandia Marathon -tapahtumaa, joka järjestetään Jyväskylässä 11. - 12.9.2026. Tapahtuma tarjoaa juoksijoille monipuolisia matkoja, kuten 5 km, 10 km, puolimaratonin ja maratonin, ja sopii kaiken tasoisille juoksijoille. Reitti kulkee Jyväskylän Rantaraitilla, joka on palkittu Suomen kauneimpana liikenneväylänä, tarjoten tasaisen ja nopean juoksukokemuksen. Finlandia Marathon tunnetaan juoksijaystävällisestä reitistään, erinomaisesta tunnelmastaan ja elämyksellisestä tapahtumaviikonlopustaan Keski-Suomen kauniissa maisemissa.
course_highlights: Tasainen ja nopea reitti Jyväskylän Rantaraitilla
Suomen kauneimpana liikenneväylänä palkittu reitti
Juomapisteet reitin varrella ja omille juomille varatut pöydät
additional: Juomapisteitä on reitin varrella, ja omille juomille on varattu pöydät juomapisteiden yhteyteen. Opiskelijat saavat 10 € alennuksen osallistumismaksusta (Finlandia Vitosella 5 €). S-etukortilla ja Juoksijakortilla saa 4 € alennuksen osallistumismaksusta. Peruutusturva sisältyy 31.5. mennessä tehtyihin ilmoittautumisiin, jonka jälkeen peruutusturvamaksu on 5 €. Tapahtuma sisältää viestit, maratonin, puolimaratonin ja lyhyempiä juoksuja, ja tarjoaa osallistujille mahdollisuuden nauttia kauniista ympäristöstä ja hyvästä tunnelmasta.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Gripholms Slott, Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 100 km, 50 km, Halvmarathon, 8 km, 2 km
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a multi-day event (11–13 September 2026) through the scenic and biologically rich landscapes of Sörmland, with distances ranging from approximately 8 km to 100 miles. The routes follow technical singletrack, coastal trails and faster sections, and suit both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners, depending on the distance chosen. The event focuses on the trail-running experience, with local food, talks and a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. The organisers offer GPS tracking, GPX files and aid-station support for a memorable weekend in Sörmland.
course_highlights: A route featuring forest trails and coastal cliffs along the Sörmlandsleden
Approximately 300 metres of elevation gain (22 km) and technical singletrack
Terrain: approximately 85% trail, 10% gravel and 5% asphalt
additional: GPX files are available to download; live GPS tracking and intermediate and final results are provided. The event is cupless—bring your own cup. Longer distances include a buff, live tracking, GPX, a window decal and a handmade wooden finisher’s medal or belt buckle, depending on the distance. Detailed mandatory kit lists apply to the 100 km and 100-mile distances (including 1 litre of fluids, a mobile phone, navigation tools, a first-aid kit, a map, a GPS tracker, an emergency blanket, a rain jacket and a headlamp). Early cut-offs and aid-station locations have been published; the organiser plans shuttle buses from Nävekvarn Camping to Nyköping (approximately 100 SEK, payable via Swish on site). A Night Trail and a 2 km children’s race are included; start and finish locations include Gripholms Slott in Mariefred and Nävekvarns Folkets Park. Bus transfers and GPX routes are included in the information for various distances.

name: Tahko Trail Run
organizer: Kuopio-Tahko Markkinointi Oy ja TAHKOcom Oy
description: Tahko Trail Run on uusi polkujuoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Tahkovuoren upeissa maisemissa 12.9.2026. Tapahtuma tarjoaa neljä eripituisen matkan vaihtoehtoa, jotka sopivat niin ensikertalaisille kuin kokeneille polkujuoksijoille. Reitit kulkevat luonnonläheisissä ja vaihtelevissa maastoissa, joissa on sykettä nostattavia nousuja ja henkeäsalpaavia maisemia. Tapahtuma panostaa elämyksellisyyteen, tunnelmaan ja hyvin merkittyihin reitteihin sekä huoltopisteisiin. Maali-alueella on kisafiilis, ruokailu ja mahdollisuus saunaan ja suihkuun Break Sokos Hotel Tahkossa.
course_highlights: 8,5 km reitti sisältää Tahkon kauneimmat luontokohteet ja maisemat, sopii myös kävellen kuljettavaksi
14 km reitti tarjoaa haastetta ja elämyksiä, nousumetrejä noin 370 m
23 km reitti on vaativa ja palkitseva, kulkee Rahasmäen polkuja ja sisältää legendaariset Tahkon portaat, nousumetrejä noin 650 m
additional: Reitit ovat hyvin merkattuja ja huoltopisteitä on useita, joissa tarjolla vettä, urheilujuomaa, hedelmiä ja suolapitoisia välipaloja. Juomaa saa vain omaan astiaan, joten oma muki tai juomapullo on suositeltava. Maaliintulossa osallistujat saavat muistoksi mitalin, ja maali-alueella on tarjolla pientä purtavaa ja juomia. Ruokailu tapahtuu Break Sokos Hotel Tahkossa pastabuffetin muodossa. Osallistujilla on mahdollisuus käyttää hotellin suihkua ja saunaa. Numerolappujen nouto ja infopiste sijaitsevat Hophaus Tahkon tiloissa tapahtuma-alueen vieressä. Narikka toimii itsepalveluna ilman jatkuvaa valvontaa. Parkkipaikkoja on runsaasti, mutta suurin osa on maksullisia; ilmainen parkkipaikka löytyy Tahkonlahden uimarannan vierestä noin 10 minuutin kävelymatkan päässä tapahtuma-alueelta. Reitit ovat hyvin merkittyjä, ja tapahtumaan sisältyy juomatarjoilua, ruokaa Break Sokos Hotel Tahkossa (pasta-buffet), suihku ja sauna hotellissa. Osallistumismahdollisuus myös lapsille ja perheille.

name: SaaristoTrail
description: SaaristoTrail on innostava polkujuoksutapahtuma Paraisilla, joka tarjoaa vaihtelevia reittejä upeassa saaristoluonnossa. Tapahtumassa on kolme päämatkaa: 7 km, 14 km ja 21 km puolimaraton, jotka sopivat sekä aloitteleville että kokeneemmille polkujuoksijoille. Reitit sisältävät vaihtelevia polkuja, pururatoja ja merkittäviä korkeuseroja, kuten Svinövuoren jyrkkiä nousuja, tarjoten unohtumattomia maisemia ja haastetta. Tapahtuman rento tunnelma ja huolellinen järjestely tekevät siitä miellyttävän kokemuksen kaikille osallistujille.
course_highlights: Vaihtelevat polut ja pururadat
Svinövuoren jyrkät nousut ja huipulla mehutarjoilu
Yhteensä noin 850 metrin nousu 21 km reitillä
additional: Lasten 1 km juoksu on ilmainen ennakkoilmoittautuneille (viimeinen ilmoittautumispäivä 10.9) ja maksaa 5 euroa jälki-ilmoittautuneille. Lasten juoksussa kaikille osallistujille mitali. Kilpailukeskus sijaitsee Finbyn hiihtostadionilla, jossa on myös peseytymismahdollisuudet Archipelagia Golfin pukutiloissa. Reitti on viitoitettu puna-valkoisilla muovinauhoilla. Kilpailumateriaalin nouto kisatoimistosta alkaa klo 8.45 ja päättyy puoli tuntia ennen omaa lähtöä. Maalissa tarjolla mehua ja vettä, tulostaulu infotaululla. Jälki-ilmoittautuminen tapahtumapaikalla Mobilepaylla tai pankkikortilla, ei käteistä. Tapahtuma sisältää erilaisia reittivaihtoehtoja, ja osallistujat voivat valita sopivan matkan. Reitit ja tulokset löytyvät tapahtuman verkkosivuilta, ja tapahtuma tarjoaa mahdollisuuden nauttia saariston luonnosta ja liikunnan riemusta.

name: Tallinna Sügisjooks 10 km
location: Vabaduse väljak, Tallinn, Harju County, Estonia
description: Tallinn Autumn Run 10 km is an autumn running event held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn. The start is on 12 September 2026 at 14:00. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers, with timed and untimed participation options. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and the city’s autumn beauty.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through central Tallinn
Participate by running or walking, with or without timing
Start and finish at Freedom Square
additional: Discounts: 20% off for seniors aged 60 and over and young people under 20. A 10% group discount applies when at least 10 people register together. The event offers discounts for seniors, young people and groups, and is part of the Tallinn Marathon, taking place on 11–13 September 2026.

name: Nike Noortejooks
description: Nike Youth Run is a running event for young people, held at Freedom Square in the heart of Tallinn. It is part of the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon event series and offers young people the chance to take part in a fun, sporting event. The race starts in the evening, creating a pleasant atmosphere and encouraging an active lifestyle among young people. Registration is easy, and early-bird prices are available.
course_highlights: Held at Freedom Square in central Tallinn
Evening start at 18:30
A safe running environment suitable for young people
additional: Registering early can secure lower entry fees. Young people and seniors can also get special discounts in the Tallinn Marathon series. Participants are provided with a safe running environment and well-organised event. The race takes place in Tallinn’s Old Town and at Freedom Square. Participants can join a community of young athletes, and awards are presented to the top finishers.

name: 84. laste Paala järve jooks
description: The 84th Paala Lake Children’s Run is a traditional children’s race held on the shore of Paala Lake near Viljandi. The event offers different distances depending on the children’s ages, from 300 metres to a two-lap run around the lake. The race is organised by the JOOSU recreational sports club and gives children the chance to be active and enjoy nature. The race starts on 12 September 2026 at 10:00. Prizes and keepsakes are provided for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the shore of Paala Lake
Route around Paala Lake; one lap is 1,200 m
Distances from 300 m to 2 laps (2,400 m)
additional: Participant registration opens at 10:00 on the same day. Distances are divided by age group: children’s run, 300 m (ages 5 and under); main race, 1 lap around the lake (boys and girls aged 6–10 and girls aged 11–12); and main race, 2 laps around the lake (boys aged 11–12). Many prizes and keepsakes. The race is organised by the JOOSU recreational sports club. The event starts at 10:00, and registration takes place on site. The event focuses on health and physical activity and is intended for children and young people.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a popular race by Lake Bysjön in Åtvidaberg, organised by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The courses combine asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails, with the start and finish at Edbergavallen. There are distances for both children and adults. The race is traditionally held on the second Saturday in September and welcomes recreational runners, competitive runners and teams alike.
course_highlights: Mixed surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails along Lake Bysjön
Start and finish at Edbergavallen
The 10 km course includes a hilly trail section (the illuminated trail in Humpa) and is more challenging
additional: Register via the link to the registration system; payment by Swish or bank giro (discount codes may be available online). Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen; on-site late registration is available from 10:00 (payment by Swish or exact cash). Distance information: 700 m (children, untimed), 1.3 km (children, timed), 5 km (measured 5.0 km, mixed asphalt/gravel) and 10 km (measured 10.0 km, mixed asphalt/trail/gravel, hilly). All finishers receive a medal; a special commemorative medal is awarded for completing the race for the 10th or 20th time (adult categories). Team registration (4–6 participants) includes a picnic bag intended for 5 people; team registration may close on 7 September if the bags run out. There is a kiosk at the event site. The prize ceremonies are at approximately 12:00 for the 1.3 km and approximately 14:00 for the 5 km and 10 km. Distances: 1.3 km, 5 km and 10 km; all finishers receive a medal; adult categories can earn an extra commemorative medal for their 10th or 20th race; team registration is for 4–6 participants; race bib collection at Edbergavallen; an ICA picnic bag after the finish; kiosks at the event site; prize ceremonies according to the prize table. Preparatory activities include a running workshop and open group interval training before the race.

name: Norasjön Runt
description: Norasjön Runt is a scenic half marathon around Lake Nora in Nora, organised by IFK Nora since 1929. The race is held annually in early September and has historically been an important race in the Södra Svealand district, with DM/VDM status according to the district invitation. The route passes through varied scenery around the lake, including open fields, forests and streams, offering a course suited to both competitive runners and recreational runners. The race has a long tradition and is a popular part of the region’s running events.
course_highlights: Norasjön Runt — a half marathon around the lake
Varied scenery along the course, with open fields, forests and streams
DM/VDM status in the Södra Svealand district and part of Södra Svealands Löparie
additional: 71st edition (2025) and 96 years since the race began; the distance is a half marathon, and the event is associated with the DM/VDM district of Södra Svealand.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail is a welcoming trail race offered over 5, 10 and 21 km, starting and finishing at Gränna Square. The courses combine fast-running asphalt with winding trails through beech and coniferous forests, offering magnificent views of Lake Vättern and Grännaberget. The race is designed to be as much about the experience as the performance, and is suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. All participants receive timing and a unique medal at the finish.
course_highlights: 5 km: mostly asphalt, finishing with a descent down Grännaberget on a winding trail
10 km: a mix of asphalt and trail, with views along Lake Vättern and Grännaberget
21 km: winding trails through beech forest, gravel roads and challenging hills, with magnificent views
additional: A mass start from the square takes runners through Gränna to the harbour, where timing begins; timing on all distances; a unique medal for all participants; the event venue and finish area are in the centre of Gränna, close to cafés, restaurants and accommodation; the courses may be changed depending on conditions and permits. Timing on all distances. Start and finish at Gränna Square. Distances: 5, 10 and 21 km. The courses may change depending on conditions and permits.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a 26 km trail race in Paradiset Nature Reserve south of Stockholm. The race features technical, winding trails over rocky outcrops, boardwalks across marshes and through open pine forest—a challenging yet scenic trail event. The distance is a round in the Outnorth Trailtour, and the race emphasises community, personal challenge and a festive atmosphere after the finish. The organiser is Trailrunning Sweden AB, and the event is aimed at trail runners who want to experience the wilderness south of Stockholm.
course_highlights: Technical singletrack trails with climbs and descents over rocky outcrops
Boardwalks across marshes and small tarns, as well as stretches of open pine forest
26 km through Paradiset Nature Reserve—a round in the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: The race date is listed as 12 Sep 2026. The event highlights the post-race celebration and finish-line atmosphere, and that the race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour. The organiser is listed as Trailrunning Sweden AB (Hästtorget 6, 312 30 Laholm). The terrain is described as challenging, with winding trails, rocky outcrops, boardwalks and marshes. The courses are marked with course tape, with start groups for each distance; start times and aid stations are listed; dogs are not allowed; there is a hydration arrangement and an after-party at Oasen.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly race and fun run in Saltsjö-Duvnäs, winding through a beautiful, hilly residential area. The event is organised by Saltsjö-Duvnäs Sports Club and includes races for children and adults, starting and finishing at Ringparken. Everyone can take part, whether you run for fun or are more competitively minded, and the event emphasises community and enjoyment. Registration opens on 1 June 2026, and the race takes place on 12 September 2026.
course_highlights: Hilly residential area with several steep hills (including Fogdevägen and Vargungevägen)
The 5 km and 10 km courses follow the same route; the 10 km is two laps
Shorter race (1.7 km) and children’s race start and finish at Ringparken
additional: Registration opens on 1 June 2026. The regular advance-registration deadline is (usually) around 11 September; registration is accepted after that until race start for a higher fee. Race numbers can be collected at Ringparksstugan on Friday evening from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 10:00 (at least one hour before the start). The timing chip is attached to the race number; 10 km runners use two race numbers (one at the front and one at the back). Registration is binding. Registration opens on 1 June 2026; distances are 5 km and 10 km (10 km is two laps); the children’s race starts at 11:00 and the adult race at approximately 12:30; race numbers can be collected at Ringparksstugan on race day or the evening before; advance registration is open until 11 September; the race is looking for volunteers.

name: Tampere Maraton 13.9.2026
description: Tampere Maraton on aito kaupunkimaraton, joka juostaan Tampereen sydämessä 13.9.2026. Tapahtuma tarjoaa maratonin, puolimaratonin, 10 km matkan, minimaratonin perheen pienimmille sekä maratonviestin neljän hengen joukkueille. Reitti kulkee kaupungin keskustassa ja Tampereen vesistöjen äärellä, pääosin asvaltilla ja osin hiekkaväylillä, tarjoten kauniita kaupunkimaisemia ja haastetta juoksijoille. Lähtö- ja maalialue sijaitsee Tampereen Stadionilla, josta on hyvät kulkuyhteydet. Tapahtuma on järjestetty juoksijalta juoksijalle, ja se tarjoaa onnistumisen iloa kaikenikäisille ja -tasoisille juoksijoille.
course_highlights: Reitti kulkee kaupungin keskustassa ja Tampereen vesistöjen äärellä
Pääosin asvalttia ja osin hiekkaväyliä, tarkistusmitattu reitti
Kaksi huoltopistettä noin 3-4 km välein ja WC-palvelut huoltopisteiden yhteydessä
additional: Kisakanslia avoinna la 12.9. klo 16-19 ja su 13.9. klo 8.00 alkaen Tampereen Stadionilla. 10 km lähtö Aleksandra Siltasen puistossa, noin 2 km stadionilta, lähtöpaikalle siirtymiseen varaa 20 min. Pukuhuoneet ja varustesäilytys Tampereen Stadionilla. Maratonin jänikset juoksevat tavoiteajoissa 3:45 (epävarma), 4:00, 4:15, 4:30 ja 5:00. Maalissa tarjolla lämmin keittoateria, mehua ja vettä. Ajanotto ja tulospalvelu MyLaps Sports Service. Etupyöräilijät varmistavat kärkijuoksijoiden esteettömän kulun. Reitillä liikenteenohjaus yhteistyössä poliisin kanssa. Tapahtuma järjestetään 13.9.2026; ilmoittautuminen on avoinna verkossa; tarjolla erilaisia sarjoja ja matkoja; osallistujille on tarjolla juoksutapahtuman palveluita ja reittiohjeita; mahdollisuus käyttää Juoksijakortti-alennuksia ja siirtää osallistumista lääkärintodistuksella.

name: Ruskahölkkä
distance_verbose: 7 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km, 0.1 km
description: Ruskahölkkä on monipuolinen maastojuoksutapahtuma Oulaisissa, joka tarjoaa sarjoja ja matkoja kaikenikäisille ja -kuntoisille juoksijoille. Kilpailu järjestetään Honkamajan alueella ja sisältää matkoja aina 0,3 km lasten sarjoista 10 km yleisiin sarjoihin sekä kuntosarjoja. Tapahtumassa on palkinnot jokaisessa sarjassa ja lisäksi arvontoja, kuten polkupyörän arvonta. Juoksijoille on tarjolla suihkulliset pukuhuoneet ja tapahtuma on osa Oulaisten Tarun monipuolista urheilutoimintaa.
course_highlights: Monipuoliset matkat lapsista aikuisiin 0,3 km - 10 km
Kuntosarjat 5 km ja 10 km
Suihkulliset pukuhuoneet naisille ja miehille
additional: Jälki-ilmoittautumiset kaksinkertaisin maksuin. Palkinnot vähintään kolmelle parhaalle sarjassa, alle 12-vuotiaiden sarjoissa palkitaan kaikki osallistujat. Kuntosarjalaisten kesken arvotaan palkintoja. Kaikki juoksijat osallistuvat polkupyörän arvontaan. Kilpailu sisältää eri matkoja, kuten 0,1 km, 0,3 km, 0,5 km, 1 km, 2 km, 5 km ja 7 km, ja se on suosittu paikallinen tapahtuma, joka tarjoaa mahdollisuuden osallistua luonnossa juoksemiseen.

name: Hiekkojen Herruus Trail Run
description: Hiekkojen Herruus Trail Run tarjoaa vauhdikkaita ja sopivasti haastavia reittejä Kalajoen upeissa mäntymetsissä ja meren rantamaisemissa. Reitti kulkee mutkittelevilla neulaspoluilla ja sisältää teknisesti haastavia osuuksia, jotka haastavat juoksijan kunnon ja taidot. Kilpailu on osa kaksipäiväistä tapahtumaa, jossa voi osallistua myös MTB-kilpailuun tai yhdistelmäkilpailuun. Tervetuloa kokemaan Kalajoen hiekkamaastojen ainutlaatuinen tunnelma ja haastamaan itsesi!
course_highlights: Mutkittelevat neulaspolut mäntymetsissä
Meren rantamaisemat
Teknisesti haastavat osuudet
additional: Numerolappujen jako alkaa klo 9:00 kilpailukeskuksella. Kilpailupaikalla on pyörän huuhtelumahdollisuus, pukuhuone, suihkut ja sauna. Tapahtumaviikonloppuna osallistujille on etuhintainen kylpylälippu Sanifaniin (aikuinen 14€, lapsi 8€). Osallistuminen on omalla vastuulla, suositellaan voimassa olevaa vastuuvakuutusta. Tapahtuma sisältää trail run- ja MTB-kilpailut, eri ikäluokkia, kilpailupäivän aikataulu ja ilmoittautumisohjeet. Osallistujat voivat nauttia myös saunoista ja suihkuista kilpailupaikalla.

name: Mälarömilen
description: After more than ten years away, Mälarömilen is back on Ekerö—a welcoming race for runners of all levels. The event features four races in one day: Mälarö Knattelopp, Lilla Mälarömilen, Mälaröfemman and the classic main race, Mälarömilen (10 km). The start and finish are at Träkvista sports ground, and the event emphasizes community, the joy of exercise and fast courses for those who want to compete. Teams and companies can also register together through a convenient group registration.
course_highlights: Paved walking paths and park trails
Signs at every kilometre marker
Start and finish at Träkvista sports ground; the course passes along the walking path north of the sports ground
additional: Online registration closes 7 days before the race; late registration is available on race day for an increased fee. The number of places is limited, and registration is valid only once payment has been completed. Timing and race bibs are used in all categories (except Mälarö Knattelopp, which is untimed; Lilla Mälarömilen girls/boys aged 9–11 are timed but not ranked). The event area is at Träkvista sports ground, with medical services, a water station just after the start/lap point, and toilets, showers and changing rooms in KOM-huset. Recommended public transport options: buses 177 and 301–311 (Träkvista Idrottsplats stop). The total limit is 1,000 runners, and all proceeds go back to Mälarö SOK’s sports activities. The race offers company and team registration, as well as support for teams.

name: RUN & RAVE Palanga
description: RUN & RAVE Palanga is a new community initiative for people who love movement, music and good energy. The event takes place in Palanga and includes mobility training, a 5 km social run with DJ music, an ice bath ritual and coffee breaks. It’s a great opportunity to meet new people, make connections and experience the energy of summer at a single morning event. Registration is required, and participants are invited to bring running shoes, swim shorts and a towel.
course_highlights: 5 km social run with DJ music
Mobility training
Ice bath at Vytauto Ice Bath
additional: The event takes place several times during the summer, including 2026-09-13. Participants are invited to bring running shoes, swim shorts and a towel. RUN & RAVE is a community event combining movement, music and good energy, with DJ music and an ice bath after the run. The event location is Palanga, and the event date is September 13, 2026. The event includes social runs in an urban setting. Advance registration is required. The event aims to foster community spirit and an active lifestyle.

name: Mjärdevistafetten
price_range: 700-1000 kr/lag (student/under 18 100 kr/lag; priser varierar efter anmälningsdatum)
description: Mjärdevistafetten is a lively public relay in Collegiumparken in Linköping Science Park. The competition is for teams of four, with each runner covering a leg of approximately 3 km. The race starts at 17:00, and there are activities, food sales, and an awards ceremony with a prize draw after the finish. The event welcomes everyone from elite teams to recreational runners and encourages colourful and creative touches along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Collegiumparken, Linköping Science Park
Team competition: 4 people per team, each leg approximately 3 km
Awards ceremony at approximately 18:15 and a prize draw using race bib numbers
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Mjärdevi Center / DoSpace on Wednesday 11 September from 11:00 to 13:30 and Thursday 12 September from 11:00 to 13:30 (after that, in the start and finish area). Food is available on site, and an After Run package for the whole team is offered (price: 140 kr). The event encourages companies to create activities along the course (water stations, performances, etc.) and features attractive prize sponsors and prize draws. Teams collect their bibs at Mjärdevi Center/DoSpace before the event (usually from 11:00 to 13:30 on the days before), and After Run packages are available for teams (e.g. 140 kr according to the 2024 version). The event follows COVID-19 safety measures in line with recommendations from the authorities and encourages a focus on sustainability in themed activities.

name: Renforsin maraton, Kajaani
description: Renforsin maraton on Kajaanissa 19.9.2026 järjestettävä hyväntekeväisyysjuoksutapahtuma, jonka tuotolla tuetaan paikallista nuorisourheilua. Tapahtuma tarjoaa upean reitin Kajaanin kauneimpien jokimaisemien ja nähtävyyksien äärellä, kuten Kajaanin linnanraunioiden läheisyydessä. Lähtö- ja maalialueena toimii Raatihuoneentori, ja reitti kulkee pitkin Kajaaninjoen rantoja. Tapahtuma sisältää maratonin lisäksi puolimaratonin, varttimaratonin sekä lasten juoksut eri ikäryhmille.
course_highlights: Reitti kulkee pitkin Kajaaninjoen rantoja
Kajaanin linnanrauniot reitin varrella
Reitti sisältää noin 80 m kokonaisnousua ja on noin 60 % kovapohjaista hiekkatietä ja 40 % asfalttia
additional: Lasten juoksut ovat ilmaisia, ja osallistujat palkitaan. Mini-Renforsin juoksut alle 8-vuotiaille (150 m) ja yli 8-vuotiaille (300 m) ilman ajanottoa. Reitillä on kolme huoltopistettä (3,5 km, 7,0 km, 10,5 km) urheilujuomalla ja vedellä. Osallistujamateriaali noudetaan kisakansliasta perjantaina 17:00-19:00 tai kisapäivänä 9:00 alkaen. Palkintojen jako sarjojen kolmelle parhaalle tapahtuu klo 15:00 Raatihuoneen torilla. Oktoberfest-teltta avautuu klo 16:00. Tapahtuma on hyväntekeväisyystapahtuma, jonka tuotolla tuetaan nuorisourheilua, ja se tarjoaa osallistujilleen mahdollisuuden nauttia kauniista ympäristöstä ja yhteisöllisestä tunnelmasta.

name: Kyröö-hölkkä 19.9.2026
description: Kyröö-hölkkä on leppoisa juoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Isonkyrön kauniissa maalaismaisemissa. Tapahtuma tarjoaa sopivat matkat sekä hölkkääjille että vauhdikkaammille juoksijoille, ja kisassa ratkotaan myös gravel-juoksun epäviralliset SM-mitalit. Lähtö tapahtuu Kyrön Vierailukeskukselta, ja reitti kulkee vaihtelevassa mutta tasaisessa maastossa. Tule mukaan kokemaan liikunnan riemua hyvässä seurassa ja juokse siellä, missä asfaltti loppuu!
course_highlights: Reitti kulkee Isonkyrön maalaismaisemissa vaihtelevassa mutta tasaisessa maastossa
Jauri 15 km -reitti sisältää juomapisteen noin 7 kilometrin kohdalla
Palonkylä 5 km -reitti kulkee Jaurintien, Taavetintien, Palonkyläntien ja Perttiläntien kautta
additional: Osallistumismaksut sisältävät juomapisteet, maalitarjoilun, osallistumispalkinnon (Sugar Daddies hunajapurkki) sekä pesumahdollisuuden uimahalli Pärskeessä, jonne matkaa 2,6 km. Maksut voi suorittaa myös liikuntaeduilla (Smartum, Edenred, Epassi) sähköpostiohjeiden mukaan. Tapahtuman jälkeen on mahdollisuus buffet-ruokailuun Kyrön Vierailukeskuksessa. Paikoitus tapahtuu Kyrönmaan Maatalousmuseon pihassa. Tapahtuma vaatii ennakkoilmoittautumisen ja sisältää mahdollisen osallistumismaksun sekä vakuutuksen. Osallistujat voivat olla mukana myös valokuvien ja videomateriaalin ottamisessa tapahtuman markkinointia varten.

name: Ylivieska Trail Run – Meleko hyvä polokujuoksutapahtuma
description: Ylivieskan Trail Run on polkujuoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään lauantaina 19.9.2026 Törmälän leirikeskuksessa ja Rantakallassa Ylivieskassa. Tapahtuma tarjoaa kilpailusarjat miehille ja naisille 14 kilometrin matkalla sekä kunto- ja retkisarjat 1,5 km, 5 km ja 11 km matkoilla. Nuorten sarjoissa on myös tarjolla palkintoja, ja pienimmille lapsille on ilmainen stadionpyrähdys. Kaikkien osallistujien kesken arvotaan pidennetty viikonloppu Kalajoen Jäkälähovissa. Tapahtuma on monipuolinen ja sopii eri tasoisille polkujuoksijoille.
course_highlights: Polkujuoksu Törmälän leirikeskuksen ja Rantakallan alueella
Kilpasarja 14 km matka miehille ja naisille
Kunto- ja retkisarjat 1,5 km, 5 km ja 11 km
additional: Nuorten sarjoissa on pokaalit ja tavarapalkinnot. Nuorten sarjojen matkat: Pojat ja tytöt 16v 5 km, pojat ja tytöt 12v 1,5 km, pojat ja tytöt 9v 1,5 km ovat ilmaisia. Stadionpyrähdys 1-6-vuotiaille noin 200 metriä on ilmainen. Kaikkien osallistujien kesken arvotaan pidennetty viikonloppu Kalajoen Jäkälähovissa. various race categories, trail terrain, registration details, free events for children

name: HOKA Messilä Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ilmoittautuminen päättyy 30.7. Hinnat viimeisen maksuportaan mukaan.

description: HOKA Messilä Vertical on ainutlaatuinen kilpailu, jossa kilpaillaan siitä, kuka ehtii kerätä eniten nousumetrejä annetussa ajassa. Kilpailu käydään Messilän lumikeskuksessa Hollolassa, ja osallistujat kiertävät 1,2 km pituista reittiä, jolla on noin 90 nousu- ja laskumetriä per kierros. Kilpailussa on kolme sarjaa, joissa aikaa on 1, 2 tai 4 tuntia, ja voittaja on se, joka ehtii suorittaa eniten kierroksia omassa sarjassaan. Tapahtuma on avoin kaikenikäisille, ja kilpailun tunnelma on rento mutta haastava, sopien niin ensikertalaisille kuin kokeneillekin juoksijoille.
