Reitti on palkitseva päiväretkiä varten ja sisältää Lapinsalmen riippusillan sekä Ketunlossin lautan. Repovesi on upea paikka vaeltaa ja nauttia ulkoilmasta, ja se tarjoaa unohtumatonta luontoa, jossa on lampia, puroja ja järviä.

name: Windal Half Marathon
description: Windal Half Marathon järjestetään Vimpelissä, Saarikentällä, jossa kilpailukeskus on avoinna klo 8.30-14.00. Kilpailureitti on suhteellisen loivapiirteinen ja asfaltilla pinnoitettu, ja se on virallisesti mitattu. Juoksureitti ei ole suljettu muulta liikenteeltä, joten kilpailijoiden tulee olla valppaana muun liikenteen suhteen. Kyltit, etuauto ja ensivasteauto varoittavat muuta liikennettä huomaamaan juoksijat.

name: Voimaa Metsästä
description: Voimaa Metsästä tapahtuman matkat ovat 6-21 kilometriä, ja lapsille on oma 2 km matka. Jokainen matka on oma maaston merkitty yhtenäinen reitti, eikä samalla matkalla juosta mitään osaa reitistä useampaan kertaan. Vuoden 2024 reitit ovat kokeneet perusteellisen päivityksen, ja uusi tapahtumakeskus sijaitsee entisen UKK-Instituutin tiloissa. Kaikki reitit ovat pääosin maastopolkuja, ja niillä on lyhyitä pätkiä sorapäällysteisiä teitä.

name: Pääkaupunkijuoksu
description: Legendaarinen Pääkaupunkijuoksu juostaan Helsingin keskuspuistossa sunnuntaina 27.9.2026 jo 51. kerran. Tapahtumakeskus on upeasti uudistetussa Pirkkolan urheilupuistossa, ja luvassa on entistäkin toimivampi ja elävämpi tapahtuma-alue! Juoksumatkoina Pääkaupunkijuoksussa ovat puolimaraton, 10 km ja 5 kilometriä, sekä kävelyn ystäville ohjelmassa 7 km Kunnon Kävely ilman ajanottoa. Tapahtuma tarjoaa osallistujille ainutlaatuisia elämyksiä puhtaassa suomalaisessa luonnossa kauniissa keskuspuistossa.

description: Vantaan kestävyyskierros tarjoaa osallistujille mahdollisuuden haastaa itsensä viidessä eri osakilpailussa. Kierros on suunniteltu kaiken tasoisille kuntoilijoille ja kestävyysurheilijoille, ja se tarjoaa hyvän mahdollisuuden kokeilla täysin uusia lajeja. Vuoden 2023 Vantaan kestävyyskierroksella pääset yhdellä ilmoittautumisella osallistumaan viiteen vantaalaiseen kestävyystapahtumaan, jotka kattavat hiihtoa, juoksua, pyöräilyä, uintia ja suunnistusta.

description: Fiskarsin Maraton Raasepori tarjoaa upeita sorateitä Uudenmaan saaristossa, länteen Helsingistä. Lähtö tapahtuu klo 10.00, ja kilpailutoimisto avautuu klo 8.30. Matkat ja sarjat sisältävät 15 km, 7 km, 2 km ja 0,6 km reitit, jotka sopivat eri ikäryhmille ja tasoille. Rauhalliset soratiet kiemurtelevat maalauksellisen maiseman läpi, ja matkalla on runsaasti pysähdyspaikkoja rannikon varrella.

name: Komia Ilkan Polku
description: KOMIA Ilkan Polku uudistuu! Tapahtumakeskus siirtyy Tuomikylän koululta Seinäjoelle Kyrkösjärven uimarannalle ja Luontokeskus Käpälikön tiloihin, mikä tuo muutoksia myös matkoihin. Päämatka on KOMIA Ilkan Polku 39 km, lisäksi tarjolla on KOMIA Ilkan viesti 4 osuuksisena, jokaisen osuuden ollessa noin 10 km, sekä KOMIA Pikku Ilkka 20 km. Uutuutena on KOMIA Sprintti Ilkka 10 km ja lyhyempi KOMIA Mini Ilkka noin 2 km, jotka tarjoavat entistä paremmat mahdollisuudet nauttia Kyrkösjärven lähipoluista.

Tapahtuman reitti kulkee kaupungin keskustassa ja Tampereen vesistöjen äärellä, muun muassa Pyhäjärven rantoja pitkin arboretumin maisemissa. Lähtö- ja maalialue sijaitsee Tampereen Stadionilla, jonne on hyvät kulkuyhteydet. Tampere Juoksee -tapahtuman järjestää Tampereen Pyrintö ry, tuoden yhteen nuoria urheilijoita ja kokeneita konkareita.

name: Vantaan Maraton
description: Vantaan maraton on yksi Suomen suurimmista ja nopeimmista maratoneista. Tule mukaan haastamaan omat ennätyksesi tai ihan juoksemisen ilosta! Vantaan maraton juostaan Lauantaina 3.10.2026, ja tapahtuman keskuksena toimii Tikkurilan urheilupuisto.

Vantaan maratonin juoksijoita lähtöviivalla.
Vantaan maratonin lähtö, juoksijat valmiina. #VantaanMaraton
Vantaan Maratonin kyltti maratonjuoksussa.

name: Pirkan Hölkkä ja Kieppi
description: Pirkan Hölkkä juostaan sunnuntaina 6.10.2024 jo 54. kerran. Hölkän ensimmäiset 3 km on katuosuutta, jota seuraavat 3 km ulkoilualueen pururadalla Leppäjärventielle saakka. Reitti sisältää vaihtelevaa metsäpolkua, sorateitä ja metsäautoteitä, ja se on merkitty sinisellä kuitunauhalla, suuntanuolilla ja kilometritauluilla. Reitin varrella on kuusi huoltopistettä, ja järjestäjien tavoitteena on ollut sisällyttää reitille mahdollisimman paljon metsäpolkuja.

images.alt_text: Juoksukilpailu, jossa paljon juoksijoita.

Juoksijat venyttelemässä ennen Pirkan Hölkkä -juoksua.
Pirkan Hölkkä -juoksukilpailun logo, jossa lukee "Pirkan Hölkkä" ja "Syksyisen luonnon syliin".

name: 55. Pirkan Hölkkä 5.10.2025
description:
Juoksukauden helmi, kirsikka kakun päällä, pääosin maastossa juostava pitkän matkan juoksutapahtuma järjestetään vuosittain lokakuun ensimmäisenä sunnuntaina.

Valkeakoskelta Tampereelle kulkeva 33 kilometrin reitti on vaihtelevasti pururatoja, metsäteitä ja – polkuja. Asfaltin osuus reitillä on noin viisi kilometriä. Juoksusarjojen lisäksi on mahdollista osallistua kävelysarjaan, jossa ei ole ajanottoa. Tapahtuman järjestävät yhteistyössä Tampereen Taivaltajat ry ja Valkeakosken Retkeilijät ry.

Pirkan Hölkän historia ulottuu vuoteen 1970. Reitti on pääosin ollut aina nykyisen kaltainen. Keskimääräinen osanottajamäärä on viime vuosina ollut 1000-1500 henkilön kieppeillä.
additional:
Valittavanasi on ikäsarjat Naiset Yleinen, N40, N50, Miehet Yleinen, M40, M50 ja M60. Lähtöpaikkana toimii Valkeakosken Saharan kenttä (Tallikatu 11), jossa starttilaukaus kajahtaa ilmoille sunnuntaiaamuna klo 9.30. Jälki-ilmoittautuminen lähtöpaikalla klo 8-9.

Tapahtuman ajanotto perustuu bruttoaikaan, lähtölaukauksesta maaliviivan ylittämiseen. Lähdössä voit valita tavoiteaikasi mukaisen paikan starttiviivan tuntumasta.

Hölkän ensimmäiset 3 km on katuosuutta. Sitä seuraavat 3 km reitti kulkee ulkoilualueen pururataa Leppäjärventielle saakka. Tämän jälkeen Rutajärvelle (lähdöstä 11 km) on vaihtelevaa metsäpolkua ja pieni osuus soratietä. Rutajärven ja Vähä-Kausjärven 3,5 km osuus on metsäautotietä. Vähä-Kausjärven ja Taivalpirtin välisestä 5 km matkasta ensin on metsäautotietä, tämän jälkeen metsäpolkuja ja Savontien ylityksen jälkeen jälleen soratietä.
Taivalpirtiltä eteenpäin Hölkän reitti kulkee vaihtelevasti sorateillä ja metsäpoluilla Suolijärveä kiertävälle ulkoilureitille saakka. Viimeiset 3 km ovat Hervannan ja Koivistonkylän välistä sorapintaista ulkoilureittiä. Tällä osuudella on vielä muutamia suomalaista sisua koettelevia nousuja.

Pirkan Hölkän reitti on merkitty sinisellä kuitunauhalla, suuntanuolilla ja kilometritauluilla. Järjestäjien tavoitteena on ollut sisällyttää reitille mahdollisimman paljon metsäpolkuja. Reitin varrella on kuusi huoltopistettä.

Hölkän maali sijaitsee Tampereen Nirvassa, Tampereen Aikuiskoulutuskeskuksen piha-alueella (Kurssikeskuksenkatu 11). Maalialueelta ja Tampereen keskustasta järjestetään maksullisia linja-autokuljetuksia lähtöpaikalle sekä aamulla ennen starttia että iltapäivällä maaliin tultuasi. Kuljetuksen ja maalialueella myynnissä olevan keittolounaan voi sisällyttää osanottomaksuun valitsemalla verkkokaupassamme ne lisäpalveluista.

name: Pirkan Kieppi 5.10.2025
description:
Juoksukauden helmi, kirsikka kakun päällä, pääosin maastossa juostava pitkän matkan juoksutapahtuma Pirkan Hölkkä järjestetään vuosittain lokakuun ensimmäisenä sunnuntaina. TU38:n kanssa järjestämme toivotun lyhyemmän matkan, eli Pirkan Kiepin 14 km. 

Pirkan Kiepin startti tapahtuu Pirkan Hölkän maalialueelta, TAKK:n Nirvan toimipisteen pihalta klo 11.30. Jälki-ilmoittautuminen lähtöpaikalla klo 10-11.
additional:
Reitti jatkuu Lahdesjärven kautta Vuorekseen, jossa kierrellään upean kaupunginosan maisemissa. Tämän jälkeen reitti yhtyy perinteiseen Pirkan Hölkän reittiin Vormiston huoltopisteellä, josta maaliin jatketaan yhdessä täysmatkan suorittajien kanssa.

Pirkan Kiepissä on tarjolla kaksi yleistä sarjaa, N ja M. Tapahtuman ajanotto perustuu bruttoaikaan lähtölaukauksesta maaliviivan ylittämiseen. Lähdössä voit valita tavoiteaikasi mukaisen paikan starttiviivan tuntumasta.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat lähtöviivalla, syksyisessä maisemassa.

Pirkan Kierros logo, sisältää juoksun ja muita urheilulajeja.
Pirkan Hölkkä -juoksutapahtuman logo.

name: Paraisten lenkki
description: Paraisten lenkki järjestetään tänä vuonna 50. kerran. Kuka tahansa voi osallistua, huolimatta siitä, juokseeko voittaakseen tai kuntoilun vuoksi. Tapahtuma tarjoaa mahdollisuuden nauttia juoksusta kaikille tasoille.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat lähtöviivalla juoksukilpailussa.
Juoksijat lähtöviivalla Pajbackan urheilukentällä.
Juoksija-lehden kansi, juoksija juoksee.
Juoksijat lähtöviivalla urheilukentällä, valmistautumassa juoksukilpailuun.

name: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu
description: Ilmaristen Ympärijuoksu on juoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Ilmaristen Metsäpirtti -alueella. Tapahtumassa on tarjolla useita eri matkoja, mukaan lukien 10 km kilpasarja miehille ja naisille sekä hölkkäsarja, joka kattaa 5 km. Kilpailu tarjoaa 10 kilometrin matkan eri ikäluokille, ja se houkuttelee juoksijoita eri puolilta Suomea. Tapahtuma on tunnettu hyvästä järjestelyistään sekä kilpailun tasosta.

name: Lokakuun Kymppi
description: Lokakuun Kymppi on perinteinen juoksutapahtuma, joka järjestetään Tolkkisissa kauniissa syksyisessä maisemassa. Tänä vuonna kilpailussa osallistui runsas joukko, yhteensä 223 kuntoilijaa ja 60 kilpailijaa, jotka kiersivät virallisesti mitattua reittiä. Miesten sarjan voitti Eero Saleva, ja naisten sarjan nopein oli Sara Kuivisto. Reitti kulkee pääasiassa asfaltilla ja tarjoaa upeita maisemia sekä kannustavan ilmapiirin.

name: 42. Munamäe–Võru maastikujooks-kõnd
location: SA Võru Spordikeskuse suusabaas Kubijal, Võru, Estonia
description: The 42nd Munamäe–Võru Cross-Country Run and Walk is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance follows trails and asphalt roads, offering a varied route in the Võru area. The series also includes shorter distances and runs for toddlers, suitable for participants of all ages. The event takes place at the Kubija Ski Base of the Võru Sports Centre Foundation (SA Võru Spordikeskus), known for its beautiful nature and good trail conditions.
course_highlights: The main distance follows trails and asphalt roads in the Võru area
A variety of distances: approx. 5.9 km, a 1.16 km mini-distance, and runs for toddlers
The route is partly off-road and partly asphalt-paved
additional: The event centre opens at 11:00 at Kubija Ski Base. Buses depart from Kubija for various start locations, including Haanja and Kasaritsa. In addition to running, the series includes walking and runs for toddlers. The route follows asphalt and gravel roads in part and also includes softer terrain within the grounds of the Haanja Recreation and Sports Centre. Shorter distances for children and beginners are also held as part of the event. Registration and maps are available on the organiser’s website. The event supports healthy lifestyles and active community participation.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. Its events take place across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners beautiful scenery and an enjoyable sporting experience. Võsu Autumn Run is the series’ 7th event. It takes place in the Võsu Laine area and is part of a long-running series. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and enjoy running and recreational sport.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Lääne-Virumaa region
Part of a long-running series
Courses suitable for different age groups and ability levels
additional: The series offers different distances and age groups, including youth and children’s races. Events take place at various locations in Lääne-Virumaa, and the route direction and terrain may vary from year to year. Participants are encouraged to register in good time, but specific registration and pricing details are not available. Other races and activities also take place as part of the Võsu Autumn Run. Registration is online, and participants may receive awards by age group.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: The Viljandi City Run is a traditional distance race held every year on the second Sunday of October in the city of Viljandi. The race follows a route around Lake Viljandi and is one of Estonia’s oldest sporting events, attracting top runners from across the country. In addition to the main race, several mass-participation events take place, including children’s races for different age groups. The Viljandi City Run course is 10.4 km long, offering an athletic and lively experience for both recreational and professional runners.
course_highlights: Race around Lake Viljandi
Course length: 10.4 km
One of Estonia’s oldest distance-running traditions
additional: Children’s races for ages 5–6, 7–8, 9–10 and 11–12, free of charge and without timing. The 5 km fun run starts at 11:00. The award ceremony takes place at 14:00. Registration and race-pack collection at Vabaduse Square from 9:00 to 11:30. The race route closes at 14:30. Race day begins with registration at Vabaduse Square at 9:00, and events run until 14:30. Participants receive medals, and children’s races and a recreational run are also held as part of the event.

name: Sõeru Kevadjooks
description: The Sõeru Spring Run is dedicated to the historic Sõeru spring, located on the Vanamõisa multifunctional health and learning trail. The event aims to promote recreational running, provide an opportunity to compete, and determine the winners in different distances. It is also important to introduce the area, offer the whole family an opportunity to spend active leisure time outdoors, and promote a sporting lifestyle.
additional:
Registration and race starts take place at the Vanamõisa Outdoor Centre (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 20), Vanamõisa village, Saue municipality, Harju County. Race packs will be distributed on 12 May from 17:00 to 20:00 at the café in Vanamõisa Caravan Park (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 18). On 13 May, race pack distribution and competitor registration begin at 15:00 in the log hall at the Vanamõisa Outdoor Centre. Race numbers will be distributed until 17:15, and until 16:30 for the children’s runs.

The children’s runs start at 17:00
The main race starts at 18:00
The youth race starts at 18:10
All races start at the Vanamõisa Outdoor Centre. The finish is at the same location.

images.alt_text: Sõeru Jooks 13.05.2026 jooksjad ja linn siluett

name: Kopli Liinide Jooks
description:
The course starts from the Kopli Lines promenade. The route continues through Kopli Käsepark, then along the seashore.

The first half of the route follows the seashore, offering beautiful views of Kopli Bay.

The route also passes through the Paljassaare Conservation Area, a beautiful nature reserve known for birdwatching. We then continue through the Tallinn Water property, where you can see how water is treated, before returning to the promenade.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race that aims to highlight the importance of physical activity for mental health. The race is organised by the Mental Health Run association, and all proceeds go directly to psychiatric research. In Stockholm, the start and finish are at the Swedish Museum of Maritime History, and the course is an easy-to-run 5 km loop around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. Everyone can take part, regardless of background or fitness level—the event also offers a virtual option.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Swedish Museum of Maritime History on Djurgården
An easy-to-run or walk 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
A course on Djurgården with lake views and urban scenery
additional: A virtual option is available (listed as 10–18 October 2026). The event offers a medal as an optional add-on when registering, as well as the opportunity to donate. Optional items and medals are mailed within one month after the virtual race ends. Information about race bibs and collection is published on the news pages (in previous years, race bibs have been available for collection at Filmstaden Sergel). You can add a medal and donate to psychiatric research; the medal is mailed within one month after the virtual race. The virtual race takes place via the Jogg app from 10–18 October using a special code, and results are displayed in the finish area. Timing is provided by Racetimer. Bag drop, an accessible toilet and refreshments are available. Nordic walking poles are permitted, and dogs must start further back.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
description: Welcome to Hässelbyloppet on Sunday, 11 October 2026—a fast, well-organised 10 km race through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby in north-west Stockholm. The course is flat, officially measured at exactly 10,000 m and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The Lilla Hässelbyloppet for children and young people is also held on the same day. This page contains all the information about the course, start, registration and practical details for runners.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby
Asphalt for most of the course; start on grass and finish on an all-weather track
Two water stations along the course
additional: The event centre is Hässelby Idrottsplats (Loviselundsvägen 100). The start is on a field 400 m from the sports grounds, and Hässelby Gård station is less than a kilometre away. The minimum age for the main race is 14 (born in 2012 or earlier); children aged 5–13 can take part in the Lilla Hässelbyloppet. The maximum time allowed is 2 hours. The course has been officially measured by an approved course measurer and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The event is streamed live as part of the adidas Adizero Running Tour, and pacers are available (approx. 37:30–60 min). A live stream of the event is offered according to information from the organiser.

name: Å-stadsloppet
price_range: 5 km: 150–300 kr; 10 km: 250–400 kr; 21,1 km: 300–450 kr; KidsRun: Gratis
description: Å-stadsloppet is a road race in Örebro that showcases the city at its best along the Svartån. On 10 October 2026, participants can choose from 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km and the Ullmax KidsRun for children. The race is organised by KFUM Örebro Friidrott, with the start and race services at Tybblelundshallen. Information is updated regularly on the organiser’s Facebook page. The race courses are officially measured, and the event is held in accordance with the rules of the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: Runs along the beautiful Svartån
Passes the scenic Rynningeviken and Wadköping
The 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km courses are officially measured (course measurer Bertil Sundin, 2024-09-22)
additional: Race numbers are distributed on race day at Tybblelundshallen (no ID is required, and you can collect them for multiple participants). Timing uses transponders attached to the foot or ankle, which must be returned at the finish or if you withdraw; a lost transponder is charged at 400 kr. Some participants receive disposable chips attached to their race numbers, which do not need to be returned. Changing facilities and valuables drop-off are available at Tybblelundshallen. Water stations, toilets and medical assistance are available along the course; water and sports drinks are provided on the 10 km and 21.1 km courses and at the finish. Parents may run with their child in the KidsRun at no charge. Half-marathon participants must turn 17 during the year; there is no age limit for the 5 km or 10 km. Register at anmalmig.nu; timing is transponder-based, and race-number collection is at Tybblelundshallen. Water stations are located along the course. The half-marathon has a minimum age of 17; there is no age limit for the 5 km or 10 km.

name: Ultunamilen
description: Ultunamilen is a recreational race in Uppsala offering 5 km and 10 km distances. The results list published for the race on 10 October 2026 shows the men’s events at those distances. The race appears to be organized by Upsala Idrottsförening, with registration handled via SportAdmin. The date of the edition mentioned is 2026-10-10, and results are published in connection with the event.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances
Results published (men’s events) according to EasyRecord
Organized by Upsala Idrottsförening in Uppsala, with registration via SportAdmin
additional: The results page shows 2026-10-10 as the date and lists the 5 km and 10 km distances. Note that external pages (such as the Stockholm update) require login for full information.

name: Umemaran
description: Umemaran is a traditional marathon and half marathon organised by Jalles TC Umeå together with IFK Umeå, starting and finishing at Tegs Centralskola. The marathon course (42 km) follows the Ume River for much of the route, via Ön, and includes a partly new, faster section. The course has been officially measured by an SFIF course measurer, and every kilometre is marked. Water stations serving Umara sports drink and water are located approximately every four kilometres. Chip timing and shower facilities are available at the start area. Medals are awarded at the finish for both the 42 km and 21 km races, and the 42 km race is held concurrently with the Northern Norrland Championships for senior and veteran runners.
course_highlights: The course follows the Ume River for much of the route, via Ön, on both sides
Partly new, faster route; officially measured by an SFIF-certified course measurer
Every kilometre is marked; water stations with Umara sports drink and water approximately every 4 km
additional: Timing is by chip (chips must be returned at the finish); race numbers and chips are collected at Tegs Centralskola no later than 45 minutes before the start. Late entries can be made at the start venue by Swish or cash. Showers are available in Jubileumshallen (basement level) for men and women. Prize ceremonies: 21 km immediately after finishing; 42 km at approximately 16:20 in the auditorium. The entry fee includes a participant medal, an Umara energy bar, coffee and a sandwich; Team Sportia Ersboda raffles a bicycle among 42 km finishers who are present at the prize ceremony. Start times (according to the 2025 invitation): 42 km at 11:00; 21 km at 11:30. Fees: Half marathon SEK 300 (late entry SEK 400); Marathon SEK 500 (late entry SEK 600). Water every 4 km; changing facilities and showers in Jubileumshallen. Registration via raceid.com; chip timing and medals included; coffee and a sandwich after the race, plus prize draws.

name: Nyårsloppet
description:
For the 43rd time, Vallentuna Friidrott invites everyone—from elite athletes to recreational runners and children—to take part in a winter race on the streets and squares in central Vallentuna. Participants and spectators may be met with challenging ice, slushy snow, wonderfully crisp winter weather or a fast asphalt course.
Nyårsloppet is a great way to get a little active before the New Year’s meal and the year’s reflections. And as some people say: “What you do on New Year’s Eve sets the tone for the rest of the year!” So take the opportunity to get active, bring a friend and run or jog around the course.

name: Craft Idre Fjällmaraton
description:
Become unbeatable
We believe everyone has the right to feel unbeatable at some point. Not in relation to anyone else, but in relation to yourself. Unbeatable because you achieved something you didn’t think was possible. Because you dared to do something you didn’t think you could. Because you ventured into unknown territory and won. You won over that little voice telling you that you can’t.

name: Tjurruset
description: Welcome to Tjurruset in Norra Djurgården—a fun and challenging trail race where determination often matters more than perfect running form. The course features forest trails, muddy sections, wet stretches and technical terrain. Adults can choose between 5 or 10 km. For children, there is Kalvruset (approx. 3 km) and Lilla Kalvruset (approx. 700 m). The event is organised by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs and is open to both beginners and experienced participants.
course_highlights: The course in Norra Djurgården features forest trails, muddy sections and wet stretches
Adults can choose between 5 km and 10 km; Kalvruset is approx. 3 km and Lilla Kalvruset approx. 700 m for children
Technical terrain with steep hills, where shoes with good grip are recommended
additional: Practical information: warm showers are available in tents a few minutes’ walk from the finish, along with basic rinsing facilities immediately after finishing. There are collection points for clothes that may not make it home. Kalvruset has a medical first-aid team on site, and all children receive a medal bearing the year. Organised by Marathongruppen in collaboration with Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK; any surplus goes back to sport. Group registration for companies; corporate tent and meeting point; any surplus goes back to sport.

name: Nyårsloppet Vallentuna
description:
The New Year’s Race is a perfect way to get active during the days between Christmas and New Year. For the 42nd time, Vallentuna Friidrott is inviting runners to take part on New Year’s Eve, with everyone from elite athletes to those who prefer a more relaxed pace. A winter race can mean challenging conditions or fast asphalt—we never know until race day. Keep an eye on the weather forecast and read our information. Statistically, conditions have been favourable for running in most years, as the results from previous years show.

Above all, the New Year’s Race is a lovely way to get together to round off the old year and have something to talk about at the celebrations later in the day.

You’re welcome too—we’ll see you there!
additional: Please remember that the New Year’s Race is a winter race, and conditions can vary from year to year. In some years, spiked shoes may be recommended.

name: Oskarshamn Backyard 6h
description:
Run a marathon distance in backyard format!

A backyard race lasting 6 hours. One 6.7 km lap each hour for 5 hours. In the 6th hour, one 8.7 km lap. 42.195 km in total. Complete the race and you’ll have run a marathon! The first to finish the final lap wins.

The course mostly follows the exercise trail and is generally accessible, though it has moderate elevation changes.

Registration is via https://raceid.com/sv/races/13769

images.alt_text: Löpare på en skogsstig under Oskarshamn Backyard 6h terränglopp.

name: Tyresö Night Run
description: 10 km, 5 km and kids’ race. The kids’ race is free. See the website for more information.

images.alt_text: Karta över Tyresö Night Run 10 km och 5 km med höjdprofiler.

name: Gävle Adventslopp
description:
Gävle Advent Race is the winter city race that everyone can take part in, young and old, slow and fast.
With this race, we want to inspire the joy of running even during our colder months!

The race starts below the mini-golf course, then runs through beautiful Boulognerskogen and finishes at Boulognerskogen Café, where we serve warm cordial and gingerbread cookies.
Honorary prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and great prizes are also raffled among all participants.

For our youngest runners, we offer the Little Advent Race. The course is 500 m long and starts and finishes near the stage at Boulognerskogen Café.
Before the race, we warm up together with our mascots, the Snowman and the Reindeer.

All information and registration can be found at adventsloppet.se

images.alt_text: Gävle Adventslopp vinterlopp med löpare och julbock.

name: Stockholm Santa Run
description: The best race of the year, with a Santa-red theme! Santa Run is a race of approximately 3 km, or alternatively 6 km, for everyone. You can choose to walk, power walk, jog or run—it’s up to you! Run, walk or roll in a Santa costume to raise money for charity. Join us for the most festive day of the year, filled with community, atmosphere and joy for the whole family in the heart of Stockholm! The whole city is transformed into a running Christmas party, with mulled wine, gingerbread and, of course, a medal for everyone! Buy your place, including a Santa costume, today. All proceeds go to children and young people with disabilities, supporting an active life on their own terms. WELCOME!

images.alt_text: Affisch för Stockholm Santa Run med texten "Your steps Their hope" och en tomte.

name: Nora Marathon
description:
A hilly marathon, most of which is run on asphalt, but also includes gravel roads.
You run four laps.
If you choose the half marathon, you run two laps, and if you choose the quarter marathon, you run one.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Nora Marathon 2027 kommer att arrangeras lördag 20/3 med gemensam start klockan 10:00.

name: STHLM Trail Marathon
description:
A warm welcome to the second edition of STHLM TRAIL MARATHON
All races take place on a very scenic course, approximately 15 km long. Each lap will offer you nearly 500 metres of elevation gain. Expect beautiful views and challenging running, mostly over hilly terrain and mostly on trails, sometimes off-trail, but also on a couple of gentler sections where you can stretch out and run for a few hundred metres.

New for 2026
• Be on the start line as early as April! This time we’re holding the event in early spring, so mark 18 April in your calendar now.
• Kids Trail, a free race for our younger runners (born in 2014 or later).
• Hjärnloppet, a virtual race lasting 18 days, where the entire entry fee goes directly to Hjärnfonden and vital research into epilepsy.
• Course preview runs. On two occasions, we’ll run through the first and second parts of the course.
• Virtual running sessions in the Heyey app to help you stay in shape all the way to the start line in April.

What’s not new for 2026
• The course, a challenging and very scenic route in the area around Lake Flaten.
• Sprint and Ultra, two trail races that challenge you a little extra.
• Grit, the ultimate test, which we don’t think anyone can complete. If you prove us wrong, you’ll win both honour and fame, as well as some prize money.

name: Tolvanloppet
description: Tolvanloppet is a well-established race for all ages, with children’s races in the morning and adult races at 12:30. Choose between two distances, 6 or 12 kilometres, with or without timing. The course is as beautiful as it is challenging (it’s not entirely flat…), with the start and finish on Ålstensgatan, giving it perhaps the most impressive start straight in Swedish running. In between, you’ll run along the streets of Bromma, with the feeling of running through gardens in apple blossom. The experience is enhanced by the many neighbours who come out to cheer, or even set up their own small refreshment stations or sprinklers—each offering its own kind of cooling relief. All this has helped inspire the race’s slogan: Stockholm’s most charming running race.

name: Fredsloppet
description: Fredsloppet 2026 is a peace and solidarity race held at several locations in Sweden, including Stockholm, between 15 August and 18 October 2026. The event is more than a running race; it is an expression of peace, justice and solidarity, supporting Palestinian and Cuban organisations. Participants can choose from different distances, including 5 km and 10 km, as well as walking categories and mini peace races for children. The event encourages people to organise their own Fredsloppet races, and the surplus goes to peace and solidarity work.

The route turns halfway at the idyllic Dragnes, where for the first time on the journey, you will see the majestic Lofoten wall.

name: Nøsen Hundreds Ultra
description: Nøsen Hundreds is not just a mountain race – it is a journey through time, set among the timeless peaks that rise between Valdres and Hemsedal in Norway. When you ascend these rugged trails, you are not just running – you are weaving through the legacy of generations, where the paths you tread were once lifelines for those who have lived off the land since the Stone Age. Crossing the finish line becomes more than just completing a race; it is a quiet victory, achieved through endurance and strength. Join us to celebrate the beauty of nature and the joy of movement – we promise an unforgettable experience!
course_highlights: Nøsen Hundreds 2024 brings together a record number of Fuck Asphalters at the same starting line.
2025 marks our five-year anniversary and our biggest event to date.
It is a quiet victory, achieved through endurance and strength, reflecting the perseverance of those who came before you.

name: Midnight Sun Marathon
description: The Midnight Sun Marathon offers five distances and a unique experience under the midnight sun. In 2025, the race set a new participant record with nearly 9,000 runners from 88 nations. This is the world's northernmost marathon, certified by the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races (AIMS), and takes place annually in June in Tromsø. The race starts and finishes in Tromsø city center, featuring a scenic route that includes two crossings of the iconic Tromsø Bridge, providing participants with a rare opportunity to compete under the midnight sun.
course_highlights: The Midnight Sun Marathon offers a unique combination of nature, culture, and the joy of running, surrounded by mountains, fjords, and an Arctic summer where the sun shines all night.
The race features a large international starting field and is a highlight in the racing calendar for both experienced and new runners.
Participants get an amazing experience of running at night under a full moon, which creates a surreal atmosphere.

name: Veressjøen Rundt Mini
description: The Mountain Race Veressjøen Rundt, which was first held in 1974, has developed into a popular racing event with significant participation, even though the race was previously only open to runners from Verdal municipality. After a decline in interest in the 1980s, it was revitalized by enthusiasts from Helgådal IL who wanted to build up the "new Veresfestivalen" with a focus on the mountain village's nature and culture. The highlight came in 1995 when ski king Bjørn Dæhlie participated, and the race reached over 1086 participants. Veressjøen Rundt has been a community celebration that has maintained its popularity over the years, with a return to the traditional course around the lake for both recreational and competitive classes.
course_highlights: Veressjøen Rundt was among the 50 largest running events in the country in terms of participants during the 1990s.
The race was revitalized by passionate individuals from Helgådal IL who wanted to maintain the cultural and athletic quality of the event.
In 1995, skiing king Bjørn Dæhlie participated, and the race had a record attendance with 1,086 runners.

description: Arctic Backyard Kirkenes is a prominent event in the Kirkenes region's calendar, bringing together the local community and visitors for a day of athletic challenge and scenic enjoyment. This unique race offers various distances to accommodate all levels of experience, from a one-mile fun run to ultramarathon challenges, providing a perfect blend of competition and natural beauty. The race starts from the warming hut of the Kirkenes and Surroundings Ski Club (KOS) and takes participants along a picturesque route that winds around Andrevann. Participants must tackle laps of approximately 6.7 kilometers each, with the first lap starting at 12:00 PM, and they must complete each lap within an hour to progress to the next lap, with a maximum of 12 laps.
course_highlights: The race features a combination of asphalt and gravel roads, ensuring a dynamic running experience.
Participants must tackle laps of approximately 6.7 kilometers each, with the first lap starting at 12:00 PM.

course_highlights: The northern Norwegian mountains offer great contrasts with runnable terrain, steep slopes, and a beautiful view of the fjord.
Two uphill races are offered, including a relay, an ultramarathon, and two trail runs.
The Tromsø Mountain Challenge has achieved an impressive victory in its debut year, setting a record in the new course.

name: Strandvoldrunden
description: Race veteran Arne Moren (72) feels the nerves ahead of the first Strandvoldrunde in 25 years. Not for his own sake, but because he fears that not enough officials will show up. This is the first edition of the Strandvoldrunde since the collapse in 1993, and Moren is among the ten to twelve pre-registered runners hoping to complete the nine-kilometer course in under an hour.
course_highlights: The 72-year-old is among those who have taken on the toughest challenges ahead of this year's edition of the Strandvoldrunden.
Emil Fallet, 14 years old, was the one who ran the fastest in this year's Strandvoldrunde.
This is the first Strandvold round since the user collapse in 1993.

name: TMC - Dalheim Rundt
description: The Tromsø Mountain Challenge will take place on August 22–23, 2026. A weekend full of amazing trail runs – spread over two days in Tromsø's unique mountain landscape. Choose your favorite race, and look forward to an experience you won't soon forget.
course_highlights: A weekend full of fantastic trail runs.
Spread over two days in Tromsø's unique mountain landscape.
Look forward to an experience you won't soon forget.

name: Explo Ekstrem Race
description: The Explo Extreme Race is an Arctic running adventure that offers genuine running joy and raw nature experiences. The courses range from challenging trails up the Sherpa Steps to the La Sportiva Ultramarathon and the La Sportiva Half Ultramarathon across mountains and plateaus, as well as the Dalheim Round in more family-friendly surroundings. Several of the races conclude with a spectacular descent through the beautiful Tromsdalen and finish at TUIL Arena.
course_highlights: The courses vary from challenging trails up the Sherpa Steps to the La Sportiva Ultramarathon and La Sportiva Half Ultramarathon across mountains and plateaus.
Explo Extreme Race offers genuine running joy and raw nature experiences.
Several of the races conclude with a spectacular descent through the beautiful Tromsdalen and finish at TUIL Arena.

name: Halddemarsjen
description: The Halddemarsjen is a traditional hiking march and uphill race that takes place annually at the end of August. The march starts in Kåfjord, 15 km south of Alta, and goes up to the now-closed northern lights observatory at Halddetoppen, 907 meters above sea level. Participants can choose between a hiking class and a competition class, and the march follows a relatively good cart road to the top, about 9 km. The average incline is 10%, but in the last kilometer, it rises by 20%, and hikers should plan for a minimum of 2-3 hours for the ascent.
course_highlights: The march starts in Kåfjord - 15 km south of Alta - and goes up to the abandoned northern lights observatory at Halddetoppen, 907 meters above sea level.
As a participant, you can choose between the recreational class and the competitive class.
The record in the competitive class is 46.15.

name: Sirma IL Løpskarusell
description: Sirma IL Running Carousel 2024 invites everyone to participate in an exciting race series with six events from May 21 to September 10. Participants can choose from several distances, including 500 meters for the youngest, 1100 meters for family fitness, and 3 km for older youth and adults. There is free participation for children and youth up to 15 years old, with awards of sports fruit after each race, as well as a prize draw at the end of the season. This year, a new trail course is being introduced, while those who wish can continue to run on the traditional roads.
course_highlights: Free participation for all children and youth up to and including 15 years old (a one-time license is required from age 13).
Premiering with sports fruit after each race, and prize distribution for all participants at the final race.
A new trail running course will be available, with the same start and finish point for all physical participants.

name: Ráidoviehkamat Løpskarusell
description: Ráidoviehkamat /Race Carousel 2025 invites you to run with us or participate digitally, with just one registration for all six races, whether you join us once or all six times. The race days are May 20, June 3, March 17, August 26, and September 9. This is an annual race carousel that offers participants the chance to experience a fantastic season of running.
course_highlights: COME RUN WITH US OR PARTICIPATE DIGITALLY - just 1 registration for all 6 races whether you run 1 time or 6 times.
The annual running carousel for 2024 is now concluded, and we can look back on a fantastic season!

name: Valestrandsmarka Rundt 9. løp
description: Valestrandsmarka Rundt 9th race 2024 takes place on Friday, September 6th at 18:45 and 19:00, with the start and finish at Furubakken sports ground in Valestrandsfossen. This recreational run of 4.4 km around Valestrandsmarka is not just for those in a hurry; in recent years, about half of the participants have been walkers who take it easy and enjoy the journey. Walkers start 15 minutes before the "main field" and therefore get to experience most of what happens during the event.
course_highlights: Recreational run of 4.4 km around Valestrandsmarka in Osterøy.
Runners start 15 minutes before the "main field" and therefore get to experience most of what happens during the race.
Entry fee kr. 30,-.

name: Bodø Run Festival
description: Bodø Run Festival is a community celebration featuring races and programs for everyone, local food and drink, saunas and sea baths, music, entertainment, and simply a great northern Norwegian atmosphere! The courses are officially measured, and during the race, you must follow the designated course marked, not the GPX route. The festival takes place on Saturday, August 23, 2025, and offers distances of half marathon, 10K, 10K relay, and 5K.
course_highlights: Bodø Run Festival is a community celebration featuring races and programs for everyone, local food and drinks, saunas and sea baths, music, entertainment, and simply a great northern Norwegian atmosphere!
The courses are officially measured!
Welcome to the Bodø Run Festival 2025 – a race for everyone, right in the heart of Bodø!

name: Arctic Alta Ultra
description: Arctic Alta Ultra is a trail race taking place on Saturday, August 30, 2025. The start and finish are at the Youth House in Tverrelvdalen, located at Sønvismoen 44, 9537 Tverrelvdalen. Participants can choose from several distances, including 100 km, 50 km, 29 km, 16 km, 6.5 km, 3 km, and 250 m. There will be aid stations at 6 km for the 16 km and 29 km distances, as well as several aid stations on the 50 km and 100 km routes, some of which will be unmanned. Participants in the 50 km and 100 km must sign a runner's declaration before the start.
course_highlights: Arctic Alta Ultra offers a new, spectacular 100 km route that follows the idyllic Østerelvdalen and ascends Tverrfjellet, with views of the Alta Canyon, Northern Europe's largest canyon.
For those running 50 km and 100 km, there is a baggage storage along the course, where gear can be sent to the finish line after the race.
The start, finish, changing rooms, café, and award ceremony will take place at the Youth House in Tverrelvdalen.

images.alt_text: Beautiful landscape with mountains, forests, lakes, and clouds. Perfect for trail running in an arctic climate.

name: Lofoten High5 Svolvær
description: Lofoten High5 is a spectacular mountain running race based on five peaks that can all be seen from Svolvær square. The peaks are Fløya (590 m), Blåtind (621 m), Tuva (477 m), Lille Kongstind (378 m), and Tjeldbergtind (367 m), and the views from all five summits are magical. No climbing gear is needed, but parts of the route, especially Fløya and Blåtind, involve steep and challenging terrain. All proceeds are used to support the development and maintenance of the trail.
course_highlights: Lofoten High5 has contributed funds to the sherpa staircase.
You can choose between four activities: High5 Competition, High5 Hiking, and High3 Competition.
High5 Competition has its own men's and women's categories with timing and an estimated finish time under 5.5 hours.

name: Fauske Backyard Ultra
description: Fauske Backyard Ultra is an exciting backyard race where participants run a lap of 6.7 km up to twelve times. The race starts and ends at a gathering place with a food station, restrooms, and seating. Laps begin every full hour, and your pace determines how long of a break you get before the next start. The goal is to reach 80.4 km, but you are welcome to run as many laps as you wish or can handle.
course_highlights: Backyard running is a loop of 6.7 km that is run up to twelve times.
The laps start every full hour, and your pace determines how long of a break you get before the next start.
Even though the ultimate goal is to reach 80.4 km, you are warmly welcome to run as many laps as you want – or can manage.

name: Reistadtråkket
description: Reistadtråkket / Dølatråkket 2024 will take place on Saturday, September 7, featuring a trail run and hike of 15 km from Rabbåsen in Sørreisa municipality to the old Skoelv Bridge in Nedre Bardu. The race goes through beautiful hiking terrain with a mix of forest roads, paths, and varied landscapes. It has traditionally been held as a hike since 1997 but introduced its first competitive class in 2012. Participants compete in age-specific and gender-segregated categories, with awards for the top performers in each category.
course_highlights: The race takes place in beautiful hiking terrain on a mix of forest roads, trails, and off-road paths.
Competitions are held in age-specific and gender-segregated classes, with prizes for 1st to 3rd place.
Reistadtråkket is part of the Reistadtrippelen, which also includes the Reistadløpet and Gran Fondo Strade Statskog Blåtind.

name: Sherpatrappa Opp
description: Sherpatrappa Opp is a rock-solid stair race organized by Northern Runners in Tromsø. The race ascends Sherpatrappa, a stone staircase in Tromsdalen that starts at Fløyvegen on the height of Lilleaksla and zigzags up the mountain until it ends at the radio mast on the plateau by Fjellheisen. The staircase, built by Nepalese sherpas from 2016 to 2019, has 1203 steps and offers participants a unique challenge. The event takes place on Saturday, September 7, 2024.
course_highlights: The Sherpa staircase has 1203 steps.
The staircase was built in stages from 2016 to 2019 by Nepalese mountain workers from a small village in Nepal.
The race is organized by Northern Runners and is known as Tromsø's toughest stair race.

name: Harstad Summits Trail Marathon
description: You will get to experience a mountain trail race over local peaks in the Harstad area. The Harstad Summits Trail Marathon 2024 is an exciting running experience in scenic surroundings, featuring varied and undulating terrain, including some short challenging/technical sections. The routes take you through beautiful mountain landscapes and give participants the opportunity to experience the stunning nature of Harstad, known for its challenging ascents and fantastic views.
course_highlights: The trails are runnable with a few exceptions.
The terrain is varied and hilly with some short challenging/technical sections.
This race offers a unique experience for both beginners and experienced runners.

name: Veten Opp - Sea to Summit
description: The Veten Opp - Sea to Summit race starts at the quay area in Finneidfjord and ascends to the TV antenna at the top of Mount Veten. The distance is 5 km with an elevation gain of 700 meters. The first part of the race follows a road, before continuing up a forest road and trail through forest and mountain terrain.
course_highlights: The race has a distance of 5 km with an elevation gain of 700 meters.
The first part of the race goes along the road.
The race continues uphill along a forest road and trail through woodland and mountainous terrain.

name: Steinfjellstafetten
description: The Steinfjell Relay is an annual relay event held in Namsskogan and Røyrvik, spanning two days with varied stages, terrain, and landscapes. This is a major event each year, where everyone can participate! The course consists of several stages with varying distances, allowing participants to experience the beautiful nature and challenging terrain. Each stage has its own distance and difficulty level, making the relay both exciting and accessible for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: The Steinfjell Relay takes place in picturesque surroundings in Namsskogan and Røyrvik.
The relay features varied legs with distances ranging from 4.2 km to 10.3 km.
The event is accessible to runners of different levels, making it an exciting experience for everyone.

name: Skjervøy 20:1000
description: Skjervøy 20:1000 is a mountain race suited for the fittest, and a manageable challenge for those who need a goal to strive for. The idyllic little island offers variety with steep paths up and down, narrow trails, cart paths in hilly terrain, and boardwalks over marshy areas. The race includes high speed, demanding uphill sections, and technically challenging routes, all around the center of Skjervøy in scenic surroundings. At the edge of the open sea at 70 degrees north.
course_highlights: Steep trails up and down, narrow paths, cart tracks in hilly terrain, and crossings over marshland.
High speed, steep climbs, technically challenging trails.
Skjervøy 20:1000 is a manageable challenge for those who need a goal to strive for.

name: Brakvatnet Halvmaraton Stafett
description: The Brakvatnet Half Marathon Relay takes place around the beautiful Brakvatnet in Osterøy municipality, consisting of 8 laps that total 21.1 km plus 337.5 m. The start is 337 m before the swimming area, and the finish line is at the swimming area. In the finish area, there are changing tents and toilets, as well as food sales. The course records are 1:18:01 set by Espen Borge Joensen in 2024 and 1:24:29 by Hilde Aasheim in 2013.
course_highlights: The course consists of 8 laps around Brakvatnet + 337.5m.
In the finish area, there are changing tents (for women and men) and restrooms (for women and men).
The relay and half marathon start at 12:00 PM.

name: Oppdalsløpet
description: The traditional Oppdal Race kicks off on Saturday, September 21 at 1:00 PM! The Oppdal Race is a 3.5 km long trail run, along gravel roads and paths, with the start and finish at the NOIL square. There is an opportunity to both run and walk, and the race is suitable for all ages. Pre-registration is possible until midnight on September 20, while late registration takes place on Saturday, September 21 between 12:00 and 12:30 at NOIL. Registration is free, and a trophy will be awarded to the fastest woman and man. Welcome!
course_highlights: The race is free, and there is an option for both running and walking.
Trophy for the fastest woman and man.
The Oppdal Race is part of the Oppdal Weekend, along with the bazaar in the NOIL house.

images.alt_text: Runner in beautiful autumn nature. Perfect for the Oppdal Race!

name: Ulvøyløpet
description: Join a beautiful trail run through the stunning landscapes of Hadseløya, right in the heart of Lofoten and Vesterålen! Lace up your running shoes, experience the spectacular views, and let the flow trails give you an extra boost. Whether you're chasing your personal record, seeking a real challenge, or simply wanting a fantastic nature experience, the trails of Hadseløya are ready for you!
course_highlights: Runners can start from 9:30 AM to 11:30 AM, and families with children are encouraged to start as early as possible and take the short route.
There will be a bonfire at the drink station at Sorgenfri, where there will also be sticks for grilling sausages.
There will be a cafe at Melbu near the finish line, providing participants the opportunity to enjoy something nice after the race.

name: Idrettsheialøpet
description: The Idrettsheialøpet offers three different distances, including a children's race, with courses ranging from 0.5 km to 6 km. The races start at 6:00 PM, and the event is open to participants of all ages. Participants can choose whether they want to walk, run, or jog, and the most important thing is to stay active together!
course_highlights: The courses are between 0.5 km - 6 km.
The carousel is open to participants of ALL ages.
Participants can choose whether they want to walk, run, or jog.

name: Nordmarka Ultra Challenge
description: The Nordmarka Ultra Challenge 200 km is a formidable challenge that takes you through the beautiful forest areas of Nordmarka, Lillomarka, and Romeriksåsen. The distance trial includes many hills and an endless number of stones, roots, and mud that must be traversed twice. During the race, participants must navigate with a map and compass, as the use of GPS is not allowed. The trails are not always clear, and it's easy to take the wrong path, especially in the dark, so one must stay alert throughout the entire race.
course_highlights: A long distance with many hills and an endless number of stones, roots, and mud to be overcome twice.
During the race, you must navigate using a map and compass; GPS is not allowed.
The trails are not always clear, and sometimes the blue trail turns sharply, while a "wrong" trail continues straight ahead.

name: KM Terrengløp Troms
description: Are you planning your next running adventure? KM Trail Running Troms showcases a variety of trail races in Troms and Finnmark, with distances ranging from 5 km to marathon and ultramarathon. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced runner, you will find a suitable race in our race calendar. Check out our schedule to find your perfect running event or mountain race – your guide to running in Norway!
course_highlights: Here you will find a race list with various distances, from short races of 5 km to longer challenges like marathons and ultramarathons.
Whether you are looking for a 10K race or a bigger challenge, you will find it here.
Use the filter to find running races that match your category and skill level.

name: Engeløya Rundt
description: Engeløya around Steigen is a beautiful route that takes you around the island of Engeløya. The course follows County Road 638, giving participants the chance to experience the fantastic nature and landscape that the island has to offer. The trip around the island is just over thirty kilometers, and the only noticeable uphill is at Mjeldskardet, where you ascend around fifty meters. Engeløya features both a war museum with Batterie Dietl and a one-kilometer-long sandy beach, Bøsanden, with an exceptionally beautiful location.
course_highlights: Most of the route is nearly flat and runs close to the sea and the cultural landscape of the island.
Engeløya has both a war museum with Batterie Dietl, one of the largest cannons made during World War II.
From the west and north sides of the island, one can see the midnight sun and parts of the Lofoten Wall on the other side of the Vestfjord.

name: PHS X Bosi Backyard
description: PHS X Bosi Backyard is a race taking place in Bodø, Norway, on October 11, in honor of World Mental Health Day. Organized by the students of the Police University College, Bodø department, in collaboration with BOSI, this is a charity run for Mental Health Norway, with the proceeds going to their work. The race costs 170 NOK, and there will be competition with prizes for the best man and woman. Participants are invited to run 12 laps, where the first woman and man to cross the finish line on the final lap are the winners, while also aiming for the lowest overall time.
course_highlights: The race costs 170 NOK, where ALL profits go to Mental Health Norway's work.
Mandatory attendance and welcome/information at 09:20, with the start at 10:00.
The first woman and man to cross the finish line on the final lap are the winners of the PHS x BOSI backyard.

name: BUL-Løpet
description: The BUL Race, which takes place on Friday, September 16 at 7:00 PM, is a popular running competition that has been held 31 times. The race will be held at Furubakken Sports Field with good conditions and expected calm weather. Previous winners include Emil Hosøy, who won the 6 km course with a time of 21:28, as well as Bente R Midtun and Øystein Aamli, who triumphed in the 4 km course.
course_highlights: Emil Hosøy wins the 6 km course in 21:28.
Winners in the 4 km course were Bente R Midtun with a time of 17:26 and Øystein Aamli with 13:31.
The race is being held for the 31st time and expects 77 participants.
